No significant differences in PR were detected among devices (P > 0.1). Arrival temperature ranged from 3.7°C to 28.5°C. No differences in PR (P > 0.1) were observed among embryos arriving at < 9°C (n = 95, PR = 72.6%), 9°C–13.9°C (n = 272, PR = 75.4%), 14–17.9°C (n = 196, PR = 76.5%), or > 18°C (n = 142, PR = 77.5%). These results confirm that smaller transported embryos are less likely to result in pregnancy as previously reported by Alonso et al. (J. Equine Vet. Sci. 2020; 89:103078). However, in contrast to their findings, no effect of arrival temperature on PR was observed, likely due to the shorter transportation time in the present study. Overall, embryo arrival at ambient temperature appeared to be a suitable condition, and even inexpensive, disposable semen shipping containers were effective for transporting equine embryos for up to 12 h.
articles.abstract_cn: 胚胎运输是胚胎移植行业中广泛采用的程序。通常建议运输冷却的胚胎（大约 5°C）以减缓胚胎代谢（McCue 和 Squires，马胚胎移植，Teton NewMedia，2015；83-88）。这项回顾性研究的目的是评估商业胚胎移植中心移植后胚胎到达时的温度、胚胎大小和冷却装置对妊娠率 (PR) 的影响。胚胎是在遥远的地方收集的，并使用不同的冷却设备进行运输。将胚胎置于装满水的 50-mL 管内的小管中的保持介质中。到达后，使用数字温度计测量 50-mL 管内的水温。从收集到转移的时间<12小时。使用目镜测微计评估胚胎大小，然后在排卵后将胚胎转移到受体母马4-8天。妊娠诊断在 ET 后 4-6 d 进行。使用卡方检验分析数据。与较大胚胎相比，较小胚胎 (<300 µm) 导致 PR 较低（n = 83、PR = 62.7% 与 n = 622、PR = 76.4%；P = 0.01）。运输设备的分析仅限于样本量足够的设备：Equitainer II（美国汉密尔顿研究公司；n = 182，PR = 76.4%）、Equitainer Clipper（美国汉密尔顿研究公司；n = 281，PR = 72.3%）和不同品牌的泡沫塑料精液运输箱（n = 131，PR = 80.9%）。各设备之间未检测到 PR 存在显着差异 (P > 0.1)。到达温度范围为 3.7°C 至 28.5°C。在到达 < 9°C 的胚胎中没有观察到 PR (P > 0.1) 差异 (n = 95, PR = 72.6%), 9°C–13.9°C (n = 272, PR = 75.4%), 14-17.9°C (n = 196，PR = 76.5%），或 > 18°C（n = 142，PR = 77.5%）。这些结果证实，正如阿隆索等人之前报道的那样，较小的运输胚胎不太可能导致怀孕。 （《马兽医学杂志》2020；89：103078）。然而，与他们的发现相反，没有观察到到达温度对 PR 的影响，这可能是由于本研究中的运输时间较短。总体而言，胚胎到达环境温度似乎是一个合适的条件，甚至廉价的一次性精液运输容器也能有效运输马胚胎长达12小时。

articles.title_en: 132   Slow in vitro embryo development is associated with decreased foaling rates and a higher proportion of female offspring
articles.title_cn: 132   体外胚胎发育缓慢与产卵率降低和雌性后代比例较高有关
articles.abstract_en: As shown previously, the “speed of in vitro embryo development” (i.e., the interval between intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) and blastocyst formation) is associated with pregnancy rate, early pregnancy loss (EPL), foaling rate, and the foal’s sex (Lazzari et al., 2020; Claes et al., 2020; Lewis et al., 2023). While fast in vitro embryo development (d 6 to 8 post ICSI) has been associated with improved outcomes and a higher proportion of male offspring (Claes et al., 2020), the relationship of slow in vitro embryo development (d 9 to 10 post ICSI) with foaling rates and foal sex is less explored. The aim of the study was to examine whether delayed in vitro embryo development is associated with decreased foaling rates and a female-biased sex. Blastocysts (n = 179) were produced on d 7 to 10 after ICSI (d 7 [n = 17], −8 [n = 73], −9 [n = 51], −10 [n = 38]) of in vitro-matured oocytes from Warmblood mares (n = 22) (3–21 yr), and transferred either fresh (n = 35) or vitrified-warmed (n = 144) into recipient mares on d 4 after ovulation. Pregnancy, EPL (loss between d 14 and d 42), foaling rate, and foal sex were recorded and compared using multivariable generalized linear mixed-effects logistic regression models, correcting for year of IVP (2022–2024) and donor mare age. Day of blastocyst formation was not significantly associated with initial pregnancy rates (d 14; P > 0.05), but slow in vitro embryo development showed increased odds of EPL (d 7, 8, 9, and 10; 0%, 5.7%, 11.1%, and 20.0%, respectively; P < 0.001) and a lower likelihood of foaling (d 7, 8, 9, and 10; 88.2%, 64%, 60.8%, and 50%, respectively; P < 0.001). The odds ratio for foaling was 0.162 for transfer of d 10 IVP blastocysts compared with d 7 (P < 0.05). Finally, the odds of obtaining a filly rather than a colt were 5.6-fold higher for d 10 IVP blastocysts compared with d 7 (P < 0.05). No other pairwise comparisons were statistically significant (P > 0.05). In conclusion, slow in vitro embryo development is associated with decreased foaling rates and a female-biased sex ratio. Although transfer of d 10 IVP blastocysts was associated with lower foaling rates, outcomes were still acceptable (50% foaling rate) with a higher proportion of female offspring.
articles.abstract_cn: 如前所述，“体外胚胎发育速度”（即胞浆内单精子注射 (ICSI) 和囊胚形成之间的时间间隔）与妊娠率、早期妊娠流产 (EPL)、产驹率和马驹性别相关（Lazzari 等人，2020；Claes 等人，2020；Lewis 等人，2023）。虽然快速的体外胚胎发育（ICSI 后的 d 6 至 8）与改善的结局和较高比例的雄性后代相关（Claes 等人，2020），但缓慢的体外胚胎发育（ICSI 后的 d 9 至 10）与产驹率和马驹性别的关系却很少被探讨。该研究的目的是检查体外胚胎发育延迟是否与产驹率下降和性别偏女性有关。来自体外成熟卵母细胞的 ICSI（d 7 [n = 17]、−8 [n = 73]、−9 [n = 51]、−10 [n = 38]）后，在 d 7 至 10 产生囊胚（n = 179）温血母马 (n = 22) (3-21 年)，并在排卵后 d 4 将新鲜母马 (n = 35) 或玻璃化加热母马 (n = 144) 转移到受体母马中。使用多变量广义线性混合效应逻辑回归模型记录和比较妊娠、EPL（d 14和d 42之间的损失）、产驹率和马驹性别，校正IVP年份（2022-2024）和供体母马年龄。囊胚形成日与初始妊娠率没有显着相关性（d 14；P > 0.05），但体外胚胎发育缓慢显示 EPL 的几率增加（分别为 d 7、8、9 和 10；0%、5.7%、11.1% 和 20.0%；P < 0.001）和较低的产驹可能性（分别为 d 7、8、9 和 10；88.2%、64%、60.8% 和 50%；P < 0.001）。与 d 7 相比，d 10 IVP 囊胚移植的产驹优势比为 0.162（P < 0.05）。最后，与 d 7 相比，d 10 IVP 囊胚获得母马而不是小马的几率要高 5.6 倍（P < 0.05）。其他配对比较均无统计学意义（P > 0.05）。总之，体外胚胎发育缓慢与产驹率降低和性别比例偏女性有关。尽管 d 10 IVP 囊胚的移植与较低的产卵率相关，但由于雌性后代比例较高，结果仍然可以接受（50% 产卵率）。

articles.title_en: 136   Effect of transvaginal follicular aspiration on pregnancy rates and corpus luteum development in noncyclic recipient mares
articles.title_cn: 136   经阴道卵泡抽吸术对非周期性受精母马妊娠率和黄体发育的影响
articles.abstract_en: Protocols using administration of estrogens (E2) and progesterone (P4) to allow use of noncyclic recipients in embryo transfer (ET) programs have been described in the literature since the 1980s. However, these protocols require continued P4 supplementation of pregnant recipient mares for several months, increasing the costs associated with the technique. Transvaginal follicle aspiration (TVA) may be associated with the development of a corpus luteum (CL) from aspirated follicles and could be an alternative for preparation of noncyclic recipient mares in ET programs. The objectives of this study were to determine the pregnancy rate (PR) in noncyclic embryo recipients using TVA combined with a hormonal protocol, and to determine if TVA induces P4 production in noncyclic mares. Noncyclic recipient mares (n = 40, absence of a CL and multiple follicles between 15 to 33 mm) were prepared for ET by daily treatment with 5 mg of 17β-estradiol IM, for 3–4 d, followed by TVA and daily administration of 300 mg of P4, IM for 4–5 d. All mares were kept on 225 mg of injectable Altrenogest post-ET. The ET was performed using fresh embryos collected at the clinic (F-ET, n = 25), shipped in vitro-produced ICSI embryos (ICSI-ET, n = 9), and cooled shipped conventional embryos (CS-ET, n = 6). Mares were treated weekly with 225 mg of injectable altrenogest, IM after ET. Blood samples were collected from all pregnant mares 14 d post-ET and submitted to a commercial laboratory for P4 measurement by radioimmunoassay. Data were analyzed by Fisher’s exact test using R studio, and P was set as 0.05. There was no significant difference in PR between F-ET (80%, 20/25), ICSI-ET (78%, 7/9), and CS-ET (100%, 6/6; P = 0.5) embryos. Only one mare out of 40 had a serum P4 concentration over 2 ng/mL at 14 d after ET, consistent with the presence of luteal tissue. In conclusion, this study demonstrates that noncyclic recipient mares treated with an E2/P4 protocol associated with TVA have satisfactory PR following ET, but TVA does not appear to eliminate the need for P4 supplementation during early pregnancy.
articles.abstract_cn: 自1980以来，文献中已经描述了使用雌激素（E2）和黄体酮（P4）给药以允许在胚胎移植（ET）计划中使用非周期受体的方案。然而，这些方案需要对怀孕的受体母马持续P4补充几个月，从而增加了与该技术相关的成本。经阴道卵泡抽吸术 (TVA) 可能与抽吸卵泡发育为黄体 (CL) 相关，并且可能是 ET 项目中非周期受者母马准备的替代方法。本研究的目的是确定使用 TVA 结合激素方案的非周期性胚胎受体的妊娠率 (PR)，并确定 TVA 是否诱导非周期性母马产生 P4。非周期性受者母马（n = 40，无 CL 且在 15 至 33 mm 之间有多个卵泡）通过每天使用 5 mg 17β-雌二醇 IM 治疗 3-4 天，然后进行 TVA 并每日给予 300 mg P4，IM 治疗 4-5 天，为 ET 做好准备。所有母马在 ET 后均注射 225 mg 的 Altrenogest。使用在诊所收集的新鲜胚胎（F-ET，n = 25）、体外运输的 ICSI 胚胎（ICSI-ET，n = 9）和冷却运输的常规胚胎（CS-ET，n = 6）进行 ET。母马每周接受225毫克注射用altrenogest，ET后肌内注射。在 ET 后 14 d 从所有怀孕母马采集血液样本，并提交给商业实验室通过放射免疫分析进行 P4 测量。使用R studio进行Fisher精确检验分析数据，P设为0.05。 F-ET（80%、20/25）、ICSI-ET（78%、7/9）和 CS-ET（100%、6/6；P = 0.5）胚胎之间的 PR 没有显着差异。 40 中只有一匹母马在 ET 后 14 d 的血清 P4 浓度超过 2 ng/mL，这与黄体组织的存在一致。总之，本研究表明，接受与 TVA 相关的 E2/P4 方案治疗的非周期性受精母马在 ET 后具有令人满意的 PR，但 TVA 似乎并不能消除妊娠早期补充 P4 的需要。

articles.title_en: 137   Pre-ovulation insemination of frozen semen increases the fertility of some stallions
articles.title_cn: 137 冻精排卵前输精可提高部分公马的生育力
articles.abstract_en: Frozen-thawed semen from some stallions has post-thaw progressive motility (PM) ≥ 35% but gives poor pregnancy rates when inseminated (AI) ≤ 6 h post ovulation. Many factors could be involved in low pregnancy rates (PR) when using such frozen-thawed semen, but a failure to capacitate in time to achieve fertilization before the oocyte ages could influence fertility. This study aimed to see if PR following AI post-ovulation of frozen-thawed semen with post-thaw PM ≥ 35%, could be improved by AI pre-ovulation. Estrous mares with a follicle ≥ 38 mm were induced to ovulate with deslorelin acetate. Four milliliters of frozen-thawed semen (≥35% PM; conc. ∼250 × 106/mL) from one of 2 stallions was AI on a single occasion 24 h (n = 15), 28 h (n = 18), 34 h (n = 18) post-induction or 0–4 h post-ovulation (n = 10) at the uterine horn tip ipsilateral to the dominant follicle. Mares in pre-ovulation groups were checked at AI to ensure they had not ovulated and then for ovulation the following day. Mares AI post-ovulation were checked every 4 h when close to ovulating and AI once ovulation was noted. Uterine lavage and/or oxytocin treatment was given as deemed necessary. Exclusion criteria were uterine fluid 2 d post ovulation (n = 0) or failure to ovulate by 48 h post induction (n = 2; Stallion A: 24 h and 28 h post-induction AI). Embryo recovery was used to determine PR. For mares which were not excluded and AI on a single occasion at 24 h, 28 h, or 34 h post-induction, or 0–4 h post-ovulation PR were 4/15 (26.7%), 9/18 (50%), 9/18 (50%), and 1/10 (10%) for Stallion A, and 2/15 (13.3%), 11/18 (61.1%), 4/18 (22.2%), and 1/10 (10.0%), for Stallion B. Comparison of PR between AI times for each stallion using Fisher’s exact test showed higher PR for Stallion A when AI 28 h or 34 h post-induction versus post-ovulation (P = 0.048, in both cases). For Stallion B, pregnancy rates following a single AI at 28 h post induction were higher than at all other time points (P = 0.011, P = 0.041, and P = 0.016, respectively). For both Stallion A and B, PR were improved by AI before ovulation. In men individual differences in sperm capacitation time can account for variation in fertilization rates relative to the time of ovulation. Hence, some thawed-frozen semen may require longer in the mare’s reproductive tract, than achievable with postovulation AI, to undergo the changes required to achieve successful fertilization.
articles.abstract_cn: 来自某些公马的冷冻-解冻精液，其解冻后前向运动力（PM）≥ 35%，但在排卵后 ≤ 6 小时输精（AI）时妊娠率较低。使用此类冷冻-解冻精液导致低妊娠率（PR）可能涉及多种因素，但若精子未能及时获能以在卵母细胞老化前完成受精，则可能影响生育力。本研究旨在探讨，对于解冻后PM ≥ 35%的冷冻-解冻精液，在排卵后AI的妊娠率是否可通过排卵前AI得到改善。发情母马在卵泡 ≥ 38 毫米时，使用醋酸地洛瑞林诱导排卵。从 2 匹公马中取四毫升冷冻-解冻精液（PM ≥ 35%；浓度约 250 × 106/毫升），在诱导后 24 小时（n = 15）、28 小时（n = 18）、34 小时（n = 18）或排卵后 0-4 小时（n = 10）进行单次AI，输精部位为优势卵泡同侧子宫角尖端。排卵前各组母马在AI时检查确认未排卵，并于次日检查排卵情况。排卵后AI组母马在接近排卵时每 4 小时检查一次，一旦发现排卵即进行AI。根据需要进行子宫灌洗和/或催产素处理。排除标准为排卵后 2 天子宫积液（n = 0）或诱导后 48 小时内未排卵（n = 2；公马A：诱导后 24 小时和 28 小时AI）。采用胚胎回收率确定PR。对于未排除且在诱导后 24 小时、28 小时或 34 小时单次AI，或排卵后 0-4 小时AI的母马，公马A的PR分别为 4/15（26.7%）、9/18（50%）、9/18（50%）和 1/10（10%）；公马B的PR分别为 2/15（13.3%）、11/18（61.1%）、4/18（22.2%）和 1/10（10.0%）。使用Fisher精确检验比较每匹公马不同AI时间的PR，结果显示公马A在诱导后 28 小时或 34 小时AI的PR高于排卵后AI（两种情况P = 0.048）。对于公马B，诱导后 28 小时单次AI的妊娠率高于所有其他时间点（P = 0.011、P = 0.041和P = 0.016）。对于公马A和B，排卵前AI均改善了PR。在人类中，精子获能时间的个体差异可解释相对于排卵时间的受精率变异。因此，某些冷冻-解冻精液可能需要在母马生殖道内停留更长时间，以完成成功受精所需的变化，而这在排卵后AI中难以实现。

articles.title_en: P100   Characterization of triploid cell lines isolated from the allantochorion following spontaneous early pregnancy loss
articles.title_cn: P100 自发早期妊娠丢失后从绒毛膜尿囊分离的三倍体细胞系的特征描述
articles.abstract_en: Equine allantochorion (ALC) cells are specialized cells essential for placental development, maternal–fetal exchange and immune modulation. Previously, study of early pregnancy loss (EPL) on ALC tissue biopsies identified a high frequency of triploidy; however, no triploid cell lines have been established to date, for functional and mechanistic studies. The objectives of this study were to (i) establish primary cell lines from triploid conceptuses, (ii) compare molecular and cellular karyotypes of primary triploid cell lines, and (iii) assess genome stability in comparison with diploid cells from failed conceptuses. Ploidy of source ALC tissue and snap-frozen cultured cells was determined using chromosomal microarray (CMA), and cells were isolated and cultured using published methods. The ALC cell lines were propagated from 6/11 triploid, 12/26 diploid EPL biopsies, and 11/13 diploid control ALC biopsies. Cellular karyotyping corroborated the ploidy status of both triploid and diploid cells. In preliminary studies, cells from one diploid and one triploid EPL sample were cultured, DNA and cells were collected at passages 3, 5, 7, and 9 for CMA, karyotyping, and immunohistochemistry. Control diploid ALC cells remained diploid at P3 and P5 (64 XX) but by P7 had gained multiple trisomies (68 XX, +4, +22, +28, +31), which persisted to P9. Initially diploid EPL cells were mixoploid at P3 (64 XX/66 XX, +4, +19) and became trisomic from P5–P9 (65 XX, +14). Triploid cells maintained a stable triploid karyotype from P3–P7 (96 XXY) with one chromosome lost at P9 (95 XXY, −19). These findings demonstrate triploid EPL-derived ALC cell lines can be successfully propagated and retain a triploid karyotype to at least P7. Regardless of initial ploidy, ALC cells exhibit genome instability in vitro by P9. Ongoing studies aim to quantify trophoblast proportions and compare growth patterns between triploid and diploid cell lines. This has implications for understanding the fate of triploid cells in early equine placental development. Acknowledgments:
articles.abstract_cn: 马绒毛膜尿囊（ALC）细胞是胎盘发育、母胎交换和免疫调节所必需的特化细胞。此前，对早期妊娠丢失（EPL）的ALC组织活检的研究发现三倍体频率较高；然而，迄今为止尚未建立三倍体细胞系用于功能和机制研究。本研究的目标是：（i）从三倍体妊娠物中建立原代细胞系，（ii）比较原代三倍体细胞系的分子和细胞核型，以及（iii）与失败妊娠物中的二倍体细胞相比，评估基因组稳定性。使用染色体微阵列（CMA）确定来源ALC组织和速冻培养细胞的倍性，并使用已发表的方法分离和培养细胞。ALC细胞系从6/11个三倍体、12/26个二倍体EPL活检和11/13个二倍体对照ALC活检中扩增。细胞核型分析证实了三倍体和二倍体细胞的倍性状态。在初步研究中，培养了一个二倍体和一个三倍体EPL样本的细胞，在3、5、7和9代收集DNA和细胞用于CMA、核型分析和免疫组织化学。对照二倍体ALC细胞在P3和P5（64 XX）保持二倍体，但到P7时获得了多个三体（68 XX，+4，+22，+28，+31），并持续到P9。最初二倍体的EPL细胞在P3（64 XX/66 XX，+4，+19）为混合倍性，并从P5–P9（65 XX，+14）变为三体。三倍体细胞从P3–P7（96 XXY）保持稳定的三倍体核型，在P9（95 XXY，−19）丢失一条染色体。这些发现表明，源自EPL的三倍体ALC细胞系可以成功扩增，并至少在P7之前保持三倍体核型。无论初始倍性如何，ALC细胞在体外到P9时表现出基因组不稳定性。正在进行的研究旨在量化滋养层比例，并比较三倍体和二倍体细胞系之间的生长模式。这对理解早期马胎盘发育中三倍体细胞的命运具有重要意义。致谢：

articles.title_en: P103   Evaluation of breeding-season estrus and ovulation synchronization protocols in mares using deslorelin, cloprostenol, and an intravaginal progesterone-releasing device
articles.abstract_en: Increased application of artificial insemination, embryo transfer, and milking mare management has led to growing interest in estrus and ovulation synchronization in horse breeding farms. This study evaluated an intravaginal progesterone-releasing device, a slow-release GnRH analog containing 2.2 mg of deslorelin, and a PGF2α analog (cloprostenol sodium, 0.1 mg/mL; PG) for estrus and ovulation synchronization in mares during the breeding season. The experiment was conducted from July to August 2022. Seventy-six healthy, non-pregnant native mares (3–7 years) were examined by transrectal ultrasonography and allocated to Group A (n = 19; estrus, largest follicle > 35 mm), Group B (n = 20; diestrus, largest follicle < 25 mm), or Group C (n = 37). Group A was divided into A1 (n = 9) and A2 (n = 10); mares received 1.0 mL or 1.5 mL of deslorelin i.m., respectively, to assess ovulation synchronization. Group B was divided into B1 (n = 10) and B2 (n = 10); mares received PG 4.0 mL i.m. on d 0 and d 1 (B1) or on d 0 only (B2), and estrus status was monitored on d 4–7. In Group C, mares received 1.0 mL of deslorelin i.m. on d 0 and an intravaginal progesterone device for 9 d; PG 4.0 mL i.m. was administered on d 7, and on d 10 the device was removed along with a second PG 4.0 mL i.m. injection; estrus status was monitored on d 14–17. Ovulation within 48 h after deslorelin occurred in 88.9% (8/9) of A1 and 100% (10/10) of A2, supporting deslorelin for ovulation synchronization in estrous mares with dominant follicles > 35 mm. In Group B, dominant follicles > 35 mm developed in 90% (9/10) of B1 within 5 d and in 80% (8/10) of B2 within 7 d, indicating that a single or 2 consecutive PG injections can be used for estrus synchronization when no dominant follicle is present. In Group C, 83.8% (31/37) developed dominant follicles > 35 mm within 7 d after treatment; in 6/37 mares, follicle growth did not begin until 8 d after device removal, consistent with delayed dominant follicle formation. These preliminary results provide 2 effective estrus synchronization protocols (1- or 2-dose PG; progesterone device + deslorelin + PG) and one ovulation synchronization protocol (deslorelin for mares with follicles > 35 mm) for use during the breeding season.

articles.title_en: P104   The fertility of ovulations associated with anovulatory hemorrhagic follicles
articles.title_cn: P104 与无排卵出血性卵泡相关的排卵生育力
articles.abstract_en: The etiology of anovulatory hemorrhagic follicles (AHF) is unknown, but endocrine anomalies are likely involved that could also influence the fertility of seemingly normal ovulations occurring before, after, or at the same time as an AHF. Hence, this study evaluated fertility in cycles when an AHF occurred in the preceding, next, or same cycle. A retrospective study over 6 seasons of the reproductive efficiency of mares bred with fresh or frozen semen involving 7,177 cycles in 2,741 mares identified 171 cycles with an AHF preceding a single ovulation cycle (AHF-OV) and 97 cycles in which a single ovulation cycle preceded an AHF (OV-AHF). A further 165 cycles with an ovulation and AHF in the same cycle (unilateral n = 83, AHF+OV-UNI; bilateral n = 82, AHF+OV-BI) were noted. Pregnancy rates (PR; d 14 pregnancy or d 8 embryo recovery) in inseminated cycles with a single OV which preceded or followed a cycle with an AHF or had an AHF in the same cycle were compared with a control group of single ovulating cycles (SOV; mares which had not had an AHF during the breeding season; n = 5,407) using chi-squared. Overall, cycles were from young mares with no group having a median age > 9 yr or 75% quartile > 12 yr. Proportions of frozen and fresh inseminations did not vary between the groups (P = 0.65). Results showed significantly higher PR in the S-OV compared with either the AHF-OV and OV-AHF groups (62.3% [3,371/5,407] vs. 48.5% [83/171] vs. 15.4% [15/97]; P < 0.001). Furthermore, cycles with an AHF preceding a single ovulation cycle were more fertile than those in which an AHF followed one (P < 0.001). Single ovulating cycles versus those with an AHF+OV were more fertile (62.3% [3,371/5,407] vs. 50.3% [83/165]; P = 0.002). However, when AHF+OV were separated as either bi- or unilateral, PR were higher in S-OV versus AHF+OV-BI (62.3% vs. 47.6% [39/82]; P = 0.009) but did not differ significantly from AHF+OV-UNI (62.3% vs. 53.0% [44/83]; P = 0.10). Pregnancy rates did not differ between AHF+OV-UNI and AHF+OV-BI cycles (53.0% vs. 47.6%; P = 0.88). Pregnancy in mares with an AHF+OV in the same cycle was unexpected given that follicle maturation and ovulation are thought of, in part, as a systemic endocrine process; this suggests that individual follicle factors are also involved in AHF formation. An AHF before or after a seemingly normal ovulating cycle could possibly alter endocrine influences on oocyte competence.
articles.abstract_cn: 无排卵出血性卵泡（AHF）的病因尚不清楚，但可能涉及内分泌异常，这些异常也可能影响在AHF之前、之后或同时发生的看似正常排卵的生育力。因此，本研究评估了在AHF发生的前一个、下一个或同一周期中的生育力。一项回顾性研究跨越6个繁殖季节，对使用新鲜或冷冻精液配种的母马繁殖效率进行了分析，涉及2,741匹母马的7,177个周期，识别出171个在单排卵周期前有AHF的周期（AHF-OV）和97个单排卵周期在AHF之前的周期（OV-AHF）。此外，记录了165个在同一周期内同时发生排卵和AHF的周期（单侧 n = 83，AHF+OV-UNI；双侧 n = 82，AHF+OV-BI）。使用卡方检验，将单排卵周期（在AHF周期之前或之后，或同一周期有AHF）的授精周期妊娠率（PR；第14天妊娠或第8天胚胎回收）与对照组单排卵周期（SOV；繁殖季节期间未发生AHF的母马；n = 5,407）进行比较。总体而言，周期来自年轻母马，各组中位年龄均不超过9岁，或75%四分位数不超过12岁。冷冻和新鲜授精的比例在各组间无差异（P = 0.65）。结果显示，S-OV组的PR显著高于AHF-OV和OV-AHF组（62.3% [3,371/5,407] 对比 48.5% [83/171] 对比 15.4% [15/97]；P < 0.001）。此外，AHF在单排卵周期之前的周期比AHF在之后的周期更具生育力（P < 0.001）。单排卵周期与AHF+OV周期相比，前者更具生育力（62.3% [3,371/5,407] 对比 50.3% [83/165]；P = 0.002）。然而，当AHF+OV分为双侧或单侧时，S-OV的PR高于AHF+OV-BI（62.3% 对比 47.6% [39/82]；P = 0.009），但与AHF+OV-UNI无显著差异（62.3% 对比 53.0% [44/83]；P = 0.10）。AHF+OV-UNI和AHF+OV-BI周期之间的妊娠率无差异（53.0% 对比 47.6%；P = 0.88）。考虑到卵泡成熟和排卵在一定程度上被认为是系统性内分泌过程，母马在同一周期内发生AHF+OV的妊娠是出乎意料的；这表明个体卵泡因素也参与AHF的形成。在看似正常的排卵周期之前或之后出现AHF，可能改变内分泌对卵母细胞能力的影响。

articles.title_en: P109   Isolation and characterization of late preantral and early antral follicles from different regions in the equine ovary
articles.title_cn: P109　马卵巢不同区域晚期腔前卵泡和早期有腔卵泡的分离与特征鉴定
articles.abstract_en: The use of preantral and early antral follicles for assisted reproductive technologies is an emerging field, and these structures make up the vast majority of the oocyte population in the mammalian ovary. However, methods of isolating these follicles may cause unintentional damage, preventing successful down-stream use. The present study aimed to optimize the isolation of healthy late secondary (preantral) and early tertiary (antral) equine follicles from different regions (dorsal, medial, and ventral) of the intermediate ovarian portion (cortex) using different tissue slice thicknesses (0.25 or 0.5 mm). We hypothesized that (i) ovarian region affects the yield of preantral and antral follicles, (ii) thinner tissue facilitates the isolation of healthy preantral follicles, and (iii) thicker tissue facilitates the isolation of healthy antral follicles. One intermediate ovarian portion from each mare (n = 11; aged 2–12 years) was separated into regions and sliced. After microdissection, all normal follicles (n = 145) were evaluated for membrane integrity (trypan blue) and initially determined to have intact membranes. Follicles were evaluated more in-depth for viability (propidium iodide and Hoechst 33342), mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP; JC-1), reactive oxygen species (ROS; H2DCFDA), and histone trimethylation patterns (H3K4me3 and H3K9me3). Overall, the highest percentages of preantral (40.5%) and antral (38.0%) follicles came from the ventral and dorsal regions, respectively. In the dorsal region, 0.25 mm slices were better (P < 0.05) for preantral follicle isolation, while 0.5 mm slices were better (P < 0.005) for antral follicles. In the medial region, 0.25 mm slices were better (P < 0.05) for isolation of antral follicles, even though this tissue was associated with lower (P < 0.04) MMP. While the quality of preantral follicles was not affected by region, antral follicles from the dorsal region had superior (P < 0.03) cell viability and lower (P < 0.05) ROS than the medial region. Additionally, antral follicles had higher (P < 0.01) levels of H3K4me3 than preantral. In summary, healthy equine preantral and antral follicles can be successfully isolated using microdissection; however, isolation yield is greatly influenced by ovarian region and tissue slice thickness.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用腔前卵泡和早期有腔卵泡进行辅助生殖技术是一个新兴领域，这些结构构成了哺乳动物卵巢中卵母细胞群体的绝大部分。然而，分离这些卵泡的方法可能导致意外损伤，阻碍后续成功应用。本研究旨在通过使用不同的组织切片厚度（0.25或0.5毫米），优化从卵巢中间部分（皮质）的不同区域（背侧、中间和腹侧）分离健康的晚期次级（腔前）和早期三级（有腔）马卵泡。我们假设：（i）卵巢区域影响腔前卵泡和有腔卵泡的产量，（ii）较薄的组织有利于分离健康的腔前卵泡，以及（iii）较厚的组织有利于分离健康的有腔卵泡。每匹母马（n = 11；年龄2-12岁）的一个中间卵巢部分被分为不同区域并切片。显微解剖后，对所有正常卵泡（n = 145）进行膜完整性评估（台盼蓝），并初步确定其具有完整膜。进一步深入评估卵泡的活力（碘化丙啶和Hoechst 33342）、线粒体膜电位（MMP；JC-1）、活性氧（ROS；H2DCFDA）以及组蛋白三甲基化模式（H3K4me3和H3K9me3）。总体而言，腔前卵泡（40.5%）和有腔卵泡（38.0%）的最高百分比分别来自腹侧和背侧区域。在背侧区域，0.25毫米切片对腔前卵泡分离更优（P < 0.05），而0.5毫米切片对有腔卵泡更优（P < 0.005）。在中间区域，0.25毫米切片对有腔卵泡的分离更优（P < 0.05），尽管该组织与较低的MMP（P < 0.04）相关。虽然腔前卵泡的质量不受区域影响，但来自背侧区域的有腔卵泡比中间区域具有更高的细胞活力（P < 0.03）和更低的ROS（P < 0.05）。此外，有腔卵泡的H3K4me3水平高于腔前卵泡（P < 0.01）。总之，使用显微解剖可以成功分离健康的马腔前卵泡和有腔卵泡；然而，分离产量受卵巢区域和组织切片厚度的显著影响。

articles.title_en: P112   Comparison of commercial flushing and holding media on embryo production in equine ICSI cycles
articles.title_cn: P112 商业冲洗液与保存液对马ICSI周期胚胎生产的影响比较
articles.abstract_en: Oocyte holding begins shortly after ovum pick-up (OPU) and precedes in vitro maturation (IVM), helping to preserve oocyte viability and prevent premature meiotic resumption. The composition of holding media influences meiotic progression and developmental competence of oocytes. Heparin has also been incorporated into OPU flushing solutions to reduce clotting of follicular fluid, although its effects on embryo development remain uncertain. This study evaluated 2 commercial flushing and holding strategies in clinical equine ICSI cycles. A total of 137 OPU performed in 76 mares were retrospectively allocated into 2 groups. In Group A (n = 73), OPU was conducted using a Ringer-based flushing solution supplemented with surfactant and anticoagulant additives, and recovered oocytes were maintained in a commercial holding medium. In Group B (n = 64), OPU was performed using a heparin-supplemented flushing solution and oocytes were maintained in an alternative commercial holding medium. After IVM, mature oocytes were subjected to ICSI. Outcomes were analyzed using negative binomial generalized linear models with clustering at the mare level. The mean number of aspirated oocytes (10.45 ± 7.03 vs. 9.89 ± 8.55, Groups A and B, respectively; P = 0.155) and MII oocytes (7.27 ± 3.54 vs. 6.40 ± 2.69; P = 0.432) did not differ between groups. A higher proportion of oocytes reached the MII stage in Group A (61.20% ± 17.35% vs. 54.16% ± 26.68%; P = 0.048). Cleavage outcomes were comparable, and only non-significant trends toward higher blastocyst yield were observed in Group A, both per cycle (2.10 ± 1.77 vs. 1.81 ± 1.58; P = 0.076) and per injected oocyte (25.31% ± 23.21% vs. 22.22% ± 31.34%; P = 0.066). These findings indicate that both flushing and holding approaches resulted in broadly similar oocyte recovery and embryo production outcomes under clinical conditions. The slightly higher proportion of oocytes reaching MII in Group A should be interpreted cautiously and does not necessarily reflect improved oocyte developmental competence. As procedures were performed in a commercial setting involving different mares, stallions, and time periods, residual biological variability cannot be excluded. Further controlled studies using within-mare designs are warranted to clarify potential effects of flushing and holding media on equine ICSI efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 卵母细胞保存始于采卵（OPU）后不久，并在体外成熟（IVM）之前进行，有助于保持卵母细胞活力并防止过早恢复减数分裂。保存液的成分影响卵母细胞的减数分裂进程和发育能力。肝素也被添加到OPU冲洗液中以减少卵泡液凝固，尽管其对胚胎发育的影响仍不确定。本研究在临床马ICSI周期中评估了2种商业冲洗和保存策略。共有76匹母马的137次OPU被回顾性分配到2组。在A组（n = 73）中，使用添加了表面活性剂和抗凝添加剂的林格氏液基冲洗液进行OPU，回收的卵母细胞保存在一种商业保存液中。在B组（n = 64）中，使用添加肝素的冲洗液进行OPU，卵母细胞保存在另一种商业保存液中。IVM后，成熟卵母细胞接受ICSI。使用负二项广义线性模型分析结果，并在母马水平进行聚类。平均抽吸卵母细胞数（10.45 ± 7.03 vs. 9.89 ± 8.55，分别为A组和B组；P = 0.155）和MII卵母细胞数（7.27 ± 3.54 vs. 6.40 ± 2.69；P = 0.432）在两组间无差异。A组中达到MII阶段的卵母细胞比例较高（61.20% ± 17.35% vs. 54.16% ± 26.68%；P = 0.048）。卵裂结果相当，仅在A组观察到囊胚产量的非显著趋势，无论是每个周期（2.10 ± 1.77 vs. 1.81 ± 1.58；P = 0.076）还是每个注射卵母细胞（25.31% ± 23.21% vs. 22.22% ± 31.34%；P = 0.066）。这些发现表明，在临床条件下，两种冲洗和保存方法在卵母细胞回收和胚胎生产结果上大致相似。A组中达到MII阶段的卵母细胞比例略高应谨慎解读，并不一定反映卵母细胞发育能力的改善。由于操作在商业环境中进行，涉及不同的母马、公马和时间段，不能排除残留的生物变异性。需要进一步使用母马内设计的对照研究来阐明冲洗和保存液对马ICSI效率的潜在影响。

articles.title_en: P115   Retrospective analysis of OPU-associated complications in a defined population does not support routine antibiotic prophylaxis
articles.title_cn: P115 对特定群体中卵母细胞采集相关并发症的回顾性分析不支持常规抗生素预防
articles.abstract_en: Following ovum pick-up (OPU), antibiotics are commonly administered as a prophylactic measure. However, their routine use raises concerns regarding antimicrobial resistance and environmental impact. Improving hygienic protocols during donor mare preparation may represent an effective strategy to reduce antibiotic administration while maintaining animal health and welfare. This investigation was conducted on donor mares boarded in our clinic, covering a total of 1,302 OPU sessions performed on 298 mares in 2023, 2024, and 2025. Among 298 donor mares, 86 were subjected to 1 OPU, 174 between 1 and 10 OPU and 38 = 10 OPU during the 3 years. Before OPU the tail was wrapped and the rectum evacuated. The vulva and surrounding area were sprayed and swabbed 3 times with soapy water; Betadine and VirkonS were applied to ensure aseptic preparation. A vaginal lavage was performed using 200 mL of water at 37°C. A sterile disposable latex urinary catheter was subsequently inserted. Immediately after OPU the mares were treated with flunixin meglumine (50 mg/mL, total dose 400 mg, i.e., 8 mL), no antibiotics were administered. The sterile needle and needle guide were replaced after each OPU. Monitoring included assessment of minor rectal or vulvar bleeding, discomfort or colic symptoms post-procedure and fever 48 h after OPU. Antibiotic treatment was performed in cases of bleeding during or after and/or fever over 39°C, 48 h after OPU. Out of 1,302 OPU sessions, only 37 cases (3%), involving 25 mares (8% 25/298), required a 3-d antibiotic treatment course with Equibactin (trimethoprim-sulfadiazine), combined with flunixin meglumine. Among these, 11 donor mares received treatment immediately after OPU in the absence of clinical signs, as they were considered at risk based on their previous OPU history. The most frequent observation among the other 26 cases was blood on the sleeve (31% n = 8), fever (57% n = 15) and colic symptoms (23% n = 6). No cases resulted in morbidity that lasted greater than 3 d or mortality. These findings suggest that implementing strict hygienic preparation protocols allows the adoption of targeted antibiotic treatment in OPU donor mares. This approach significantly reduces antibiotic use without increasing post-procedural complications, while preserving donor mare welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 在卵母细胞采集（OPU）后，通常使用抗生素作为预防措施。然而，其常规使用引发了关于抗菌药物耐药性和环境影响的担忧。改善供体母马准备过程中的卫生规程可能是一种有效策略，可在维持动物健康与福利的同时减少抗生素使用。本研究针对我们诊所收治的供体母马进行，涵盖了2023、2024和2025年间对298匹母马进行的共1,302次OPU操作。在298匹供体母马中，86匹接受了1次OPU，174匹接受了1至10次OPU，38匹在3年间接受了10次OPU。OPU前，尾巴被包裹，直肠被排空。外阴及周围区域用肥皂水喷洒并擦拭3次；使用Betadine和VirkonS确保无菌准备。使用200毫升37°C的水进行阴道灌洗。随后插入无菌一次性乳胶导尿管。OPU后立即给予马匹氟尼辛葡甲胺（50 mg/mL，总剂量400 mg，即8 mL），未使用抗生素。每次OPU后更换无菌针头和针导。监测包括评估术后轻微直肠或外阴出血、不适或绞痛症状，以及OPU后48小时的发热情况。在OPU期间或之后出血和/或OPU后48小时体温超过39°C的情况下，进行抗生素治疗。在1,302次OPU操作中，仅有37例（3%），涉及25匹母马（8% 25/298），需要为期3天的Equibactin（甲氧苄啶-磺胺嘧啶）抗生素治疗，并与氟尼辛葡甲胺联合使用。其中，11匹供体母马在OPU后立即接受治疗，尽管没有临床症状，但根据其既往OPU史被认为存在风险。其余26例中最常见的观察结果是袖套上的血液（31% n = 8）、发热（57% n = 15）和绞痛症状（23% n = 6）。没有病例导致持续超过3天的发病率或死亡。这些发现表明，实施严格的卫生准备规程允许在OPU供体母马中采用针对性抗生素治疗。这种方法显著减少了抗生素使用，且不增加术后并发症，同时保障了供体母马的福利。

articles.title_en: P117   Cholesterol efflux during in vitro capacitation of equine spermatozoa is time-dependent and independent of egg yolk–based extenders used during semen processing
articles.title_cn: P117 马精子体外获能过程中的胆固醇外流具有时间依赖性，且与精液处理中使用的蛋黄基础稀释液无关
articles.abstract_en: Cholesterol efflux from the sperm plasma membrane is an early event of mammalian sperm capacitation associated with the acquisition of fertilizing competence. In horses, difficulties in maintaining capacitation in vitro remain a limitation for conventional IVF systems. This study evaluated whether egg yolk–based extenders differing in cholesterol and casein composition influence cholesterol efflux during in vitro capacitation of frozen-thawed equine spermatozoa and characterized its temporal pattern. Frozen semen from 9 stallions was processed using 4 extender combinations. During centrifugation, semen was diluted in BotuSemen GOLDⓇ (cholesterol + casein) or BotuSemen KZⓇ (casein without cholesterol). For freezing, samples were resuspended in BotuCRIOⓇ or an alternative egg yolk–based extender (G2) containing 4% glycerol and no amides. After thawing, spermatozoa were incubated under capacitating conditions. Cholesterol efflux was evaluated by flow cytometry using BODIPY-cholesterol, analyzing at least 10,000 sperm events per sample. Reduced membrane fluorescence was used to identify sperm exhibiting cholesterol efflux, evaluated in total and viable populations (propidium iodide exclusion). Data were analyzed using linear mixed models with Tukey’s test (P < 0.05). Evaluations were performed at 0.5, 3, 6, and 9 h of incubation. Extender combinations did not affect membrane integrity, total capacitation or capacitation of viable spermatozoa. In contrast, incubation time significantly influenced cholesterol efflux dynamics. The highest proportions of sperm exhibiting cholesterol efflux were observed at early incubation times, with approximately 40–45% of sperm showing reduced BODIPY fluorescence at 0.5–3 h. After 6 h, this proportion decreased to ∼25–27% and remained stable up to 9 h. These findings indicate that cholesterol efflux in frozen-thawed equine spermatozoa is a rapid and time-dependent process occurring mainly within the first 3 h of incubation, and is independent of the egg yolk–based extenders used during semen processing.
articles.abstract_cn: 精子质膜的胆固醇外流是哺乳动物精子获能的早期事件，与受精能力的获得相关。在马中，体外维持获能的困难仍是传统体外受精系统的限制因素。本研究评估了在冷冻-解冻马精子体外获能过程中，胆固醇和酪蛋白组成不同的蛋黄基础稀释液是否影响胆固醇外流，并表征了其时间模式。来自9匹公马的精液使用4种稀释液组合进行处理。在离心过程中，精液用BotuSemen GOLDⓇ（含胆固醇和酪蛋白）或BotuSemen KZⓇ（含酪蛋白但不含胆固醇）稀释。冷冻时，样本重悬于BotuCRIOⓇ或另一种含4%甘油且不含酰胺的蛋黄基础稀释液（G2）中。解冻后，精子在获能条件下孵育。胆固醇外流通过流式细胞术使用BODIPY-胆固醇评估，每个样本至少分析10,000个精子事件。膜荧光降低用于识别表现出胆固醇外流的精子，在总群体和活群体（碘化丙啶排除）中评估。数据使用线性混合模型和Tukey检验（P < 0.05）进行分析。评估在孵育的0.5、3、6和9小时进行。稀释液组合不影响膜完整性、总获能或活精子的获能。相反，孵育时间显著影响胆固醇外流动态。表现出胆固醇外流的精子比例在早期孵育时间最高，约40-45%的精子在0.5-3小时显示BODIPY荧光降低。在6小时后，该比例降至约25-27%%，并保持稳定至9小时。这些发现表明，冷冻-解冻马精子的胆固醇外流是一个快速且时间依赖的过程，主要发生在孵育的前3小时内，且与精液处理中使用的蛋黄基础稀释液无关。

articles.title_en: P119   Transferred ICSI embryos do not align themselves to recipient uterine age
articles.title_cn: P119   移植的 ICSI 胚胎与受体子宫年龄不相符
articles.abstract_en: Embryo age in vivo is calculated from the day of ovulation (d 0). Whereas ICSI embryo age is calculated from the day of sperm injection. However, development in vitro does not mirror that of in vivo embryos and when cryopreserved at d 7–9 ICSI embryos are smaller than d 7–9 in vivo embryos. Morphologically they are developmentally behind, with a small blastocoele and still in the zona pellucida. Hence, transfer is usually to d 4–5 recipients. Studies have shown that in vivo embryos transferred to a negatively asynchronous uterus align their development to uterine rather than embryonic age. Hence, this study aimed to see if early development of ICSI embryos was delayed and aligned itself with recipient uterine age. Five warmed vitrified ICSI embryos were transferred to d 5 (n = 3) or 4 (n = 2) recipients. Mares were examined for pregnancy at recipient d 9 and at regular intervals thereafter. Individual and mean diameters of ICSI or viable in vivo, non-ET embryos (CON; n = 6) were compared using the t-test on uterine age days (d 10, 12, 14, 16, and 18). Recipients and control mares were not given any hormones or antibiotics. Three of the 5 ICSI embryos were first visualized at recipient d 9 (mean ± SD; 3.6 ± 1.1 mm), but none of the in vivo embryos were seen at this time. Despite mean ISCI embryo diameter (mm) being greater than CON embryos at all time points, this was only significant at d 10 and 12 (d 10: 7.1 ± 2.1 vs. 1.8 ± 0.5, P < 0.001; d 12: 11.9 ± 5.3 vs. 6.4 ± 1.3, P = 0.03; d 14: 19.1 ± 5.4 vs. 14.3 ± 1.8, P = 0.07; d 16: 25.7 ± 3.5 vs. 22.0 ± 2.9, P = 0.11; d 18: 27.0 ± 1.8 vs. 25.1 ± 1.6, P = 0.14). First appearance of the embryo proper in the ICSI pregnancies occurred when the recipient was d 15 (n = 2), d 17 (n = 1), or d 18 (n = 2), which was earlier than CON pregnancies (16.6 ± 1.5 vs. 21.6 ± 1.39 d, P < 0.001). Unlike the situation with in vivo embryos transferred to negatively asynchronous uteri, ICSI embryos showed enhanced development when placed in a uterus 3–4 d behind their age post injection. This is more akin to the situation with cattle and sheep embryos that show enhancement when transferred to an advanced uterine environment. The enhanced development seen in ICSI embryos when transferred to a less advanced uterine environment may relate to the change from an in vitro to an in vivo environment at transfer. However, the mechanisms underlying enhanced development post transfer remain to be elucidated.
articles.abstract_cn: 体内胚胎年龄从排卵日 (d 0) 开始计算。而 ICSI 胚胎年龄是从精子注射之日开始计算的。然而，体外发育并不反映体内胚胎的发育情况，当冷冻保存在 d 7-9 时，ICSI 胚胎比 d 7-9 体内胚胎小。从形态上看，它们发育落后，囊胚腔很小，但仍位于透明带中。因此，转账通常发送至 d 4-5 个收件人。研究表明，移植到负异步子宫的体内胚胎使其发育与子宫而不是胚胎年龄一致。因此，本研究旨在了解 ICSI 胚胎的早期发育是否被延迟并与受体子宫年龄保持一致。将五个加热的玻璃化 ICSI 胚胎转移至 d 5 (n = 3) 或 4 (n = 2) 受体。在受者 d 9 时检查母马是否怀孕，此后定期检查。使用子宫年龄天数（d 10、12、14、16 和 18）的 t 检验比较 ICSI 或活体非 ET 胚胎（CON；n = 6）的个体直径和平均直径。接受者和对照母马没有服用任何激素或抗生素。三个 5 ICSI 胚胎首先在受体 d 9（平均值±SD；3.6±1.1 mm）处可见，但此时没有看到任何体内胚胎。尽管在所有时间点平均 ISCI 胚胎直径 (mm) 均大于 CON 胚胎，但这仅在 d 10 和 12 时显着（d 10：7.1 ± 2.1 与 1.8 ± 0.5，P < 0.001；d 12：11.9 ± 5.3 vs. 6.4 ± 1.3，P = 0.03；d 14：19.1 ± 5.4 vs. 14.3 ± 1.8，P = 0.07；d 16：25.7 ± 3.5 22.0 ± 2.9，P = 0.11；d 18：27.0 ± 1.8 与 25.1 ± 1.6，P = 0.14）。 ICSI 妊娠中胚胎首次出现的时间为受者 d 15 (n = 2)、d 17 (n = 1) 或 d 18 (n = 2)，这早于 CON 妊娠 (16.6 ± 1.5 与 21.6 ± 1.39 d，P < 0.001）。与体内胚胎转移到负异步子宫的情况不同，ICSI 胚胎在注射后年龄 3-4 d 放置在子宫中时显示出增强的发育。这更类似于牛和羊胚胎的情况，当转移到高级子宫环境时，它们会表现出增强。当 ICSI 胚胎转移到不太先进的子宫环境时，观察到的发育增强可能与转移时从体外环境到体内环境的变化有关。然而，转移后促进发展的机制仍有待阐明。

articles.title_en: P120   Using OPU-ICSI to breed Hokkaido Native Ponies in Japan
articles.title_cn: P120 利用OPU-ICSI在日本繁殖北海道原生马
articles.abstract_en: Ovum pick-up (OPU) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) represents a breakthrough technology in equine production. A major advantage of OPU is that multiple early blastocysts can be produced in a single session. However, research into equine OPU and ICSI is limited in Japan. The objectives of this study were (1) to evaluate the feasibility of OPU-ICSI in Hokkaido native horses and crossbreds, and (2) to assist conservation of this valuable native breed through the application of OPU-ICSI. Ten Hokkaido native or crossbred mares were used as oocyte donors. OPU was performed on mares without a dominant follicle and with a high number of follicles = 10 mm in diameter. All follicles = 2 mm in diameter were aspirated using a 12 G double-lumen needle. After puncture and aspiration of follicular fluid, each follicle was flushed 6 times with oocyte recovery medium while gently scraping the follicular wall. Aspirated fluid was filtered, and cumulus–oocyte complexes (COC) were identified under a stereomicroscope. Recovered COC were matured in vitro for 30 h. Following in vitro maturation (IVM), oocytes that reached the metaphase II (MII) stage were subjected to ICSI. Injected oocytes were cultured in the incubation until d 7–8 post-ICSI. Embryos that developed to the early blastocyst stage were vitrified and stored in liquid nitrogen. A total of 41 OPU-ICSI sessions were performed in this study. A total of 509 oocytes were recovered from 1,216 aspirated follicles (overall recovery rate of 41.9%). Of the 451 COC selected for IVM, 304 matured to the MII stage, yielding a maturation rate of 67.4%. Following ICSI, 304 embryos were produced, of which 151 developed to at least the 2-cell stage (i.e., a cleavage rate of 49.8%). Ultimately, 12 reached the early blastocyst stage, and 2 developed to the blastocyst stage; all were cryopreserved. Subsequently, 8 early blastocysts were thawed and transferred to recipient mares and one healthy foal was born. This study reports the first successful birth of a foal produced by OPU-ICSI in Japan. These findings demonstrate that OPU-ICSI may be a feasible assisted reproductive technology in Hokkaido native horses. With optimization, this technology is expected to contribute to the conservation of rare equine breeds and to the genetic improvement of horses.
articles.abstract_cn: 卵母细胞采集（OPU）和胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）代表了马科动物生产中的一项突破性技术。OPU的一个主要优势是可以在单次操作中产生多个早期囊胚。然而，日本对马科动物OPU和ICSI的研究有限。本研究的目标是（1）评估OPU-ICSI在北海道原生马及其杂交种中的可行性，以及（2）通过应用OPU-ICSI协助保护这一珍贵的原生品种。研究使用了十匹北海道原生或杂交母马作为卵母细胞供体。对无优势卵泡且卵泡数量高（直径等于10毫米）的母马进行OPU。所有直径等于2毫米的卵泡均使用12 G双腔针进行抽吸。穿刺并抽吸卵泡液后，每个卵泡用卵母细胞回收培养基冲洗6次，同时轻轻刮擦卵泡壁。抽吸的液体经过过滤，并在体视显微镜下识别卵丘-卵母细胞复合体（COC）。回收的COC在体外成熟30小时。体外成熟（IVM）后，达到第二次减数分裂中期（MII）阶段的卵母细胞进行ICSI。注射后的卵母细胞在培养箱中培养至ICSI后第7-8天。发育到早期囊胚阶段的胚胎被玻璃化冷冻并储存在液氮中。本研究共进行了41次OPU-ICSI操作。从1,216个抽吸的卵泡中总共回收了509个卵母细胞（总回收率为41.9%）。在选用于IVM的451个COC中，304个成熟到MII阶段，成熟率为67.4%。ICSI后，产生了304个胚胎，其中151个发育到至少2细胞阶段（即卵裂率为49.8%）。最终，12个达到早期囊胚阶段，2个发育到囊胚阶段；所有胚胎均被冷冻保存。随后，8个早期囊胚被解冻并移植到受体母马体内，产下了一匹健康的马驹。本研究报道了日本首例通过OPU-ICSI成功产下马驹的案例。这些发现表明，OPU-ICSI可能是北海道原生马的一种可行的辅助生殖技术。通过优化，该技术有望为稀有马品种的保护和马的遗传改良做出贡献。

articles.title_en: P126   A novel single-step thawing method for in vitro-produced equine embryos
articles.title_cn: 一种用于体外生产马胚胎的新型单步解冻方法
articles.abstract_en: The global rise of in vitro-produced (IVP) embryo use has driven the development of simplified thawing methods that maintain embryo quality and pregnancy rates while reducing time and technical demands. These advances underscore the need for a fast-thawing method that allows safe IVP embryo transfer without specialized facilities or advanced expertise, improving usability in field settings. The aim of this study was to evaluate whether a novel single-step thawing method for equine IVP embryos produced by somatic cell nuclear transfer (SCNT) yields pregnancy outcomes comparable to the commercial 3-step KitazatoⓇ thawing protocol. A total of 77 cloned equine embryos were included, with 45 thawed using the 3-step protocol and 32 using the novel single-step method. These embryos were derived from 31 different donor cell lines across both groups. Only d 6 to 7 grade I and II (IETS) blastocysts vitrified by a single embryologist using the KitazatoⓇ vitrification media and CryotopⓇ were selected. Embryo transfer was performed conventionally into d 4 synchronized mares within 5 min of thawing. For the novel single-step thawing method, the CryotopⓇ containing the vitrified embryo was transferred directly from liquid nitrogen into 0.1 mL of pre-warmed media at 38.5°C (containing H-SOF + 10% FBS and 0.2 M sucrose) within a sterile 0.25-mL straw. Thawing was conducted by operators with varying levels of experience, including an embryologist, reproductive veterinarians, and an inexperienced technician. Stereomicroscopic assessment confirmed correct embryo placement within the transfer straw in 100% of procedures. Pregnancy rates at 14 d were significantly higher for embryos thawed using the single-step compared with the 3-step method (68.8% vs. 35.6%, P < 0.05). However, pregnancy loss before 25 d (36.4% vs. 25%), beyond 25 d (35.7% vs. 16.7%), and live foal rates (28.1% vs. 22.2%) did not differ significantly (P = 0.05). Overall, the single-step thawing technique represents a practical, safe, and simplified alternative to conventional laboratory-based thawing, eliminating the need for specialized equipment or training and reducing handling time without compromising overall pregnancy outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 体外生产（IVP）胚胎使用的全球增长推动了简化解冻方法的发展，这些方法在保持胚胎质量和妊娠率的同时，减少了时间和技术要求。这些进展强调了需要一种快速解冻方法，使得无需专门设施或高级专业知识即可安全进行IVP胚胎移植，提高现场环境中的可用性。本研究旨在评估一种用于体细胞核移植（SCNT）生产的马IVP胚胎的新型单步解冻方法，其妊娠结局是否与商业化的3步KitazatoⓇ解冻方案相当。共纳入77个克隆马胚胎，其中45个使用3步方案解冻，32个使用新型单步方法。这些胚胎来自两组中的31个不同供体细胞系。仅选择由单一胚胎学家使用KitazatoⓇ玻璃化培养基和CryotopⓇ玻璃化的d 6至7期I级和II级（IETS）囊胚。胚胎移植在解冻后5分钟内常规进行到d 4同步化的母马中。对于新型单步解冻方法，含有玻璃化胚胎的CryotopⓇ直接从液氮中转移到预热的0.1 mL培养基中（含有H-SOF + 10%胎牛血清和0.2 M蔗糖），温度为38.5°C，置于无菌的0.25-mL细管中。解冻由具有不同经验水平的操作者进行，包括胚胎学家、生殖兽医和一名无经验的技术员。体视显微镜评估确认在100%的操作中胚胎正确放置在移植细管内。第14天的妊娠率，使用单步方法解冻的胚胎显著高于使用3步方法的胚胎（68.8%对比35.6%，P < 0.05）。然而，第25天前的妊娠丢失（36.4%对比25%）、第25天后的妊娠丢失（35.7%对比16.7%）以及活驹率（28.1%对比22.2%）没有显著差异（P = 0.05）。总体而言，单步解冻技术代表了一种实用、安全且简化的替代传统实验室解冻的方法，无需专门设备或培训，减少了处理时间，且不损害总体妊娠结局。

articles.title_en: P128   Clinical outcomes of equine in vitro embryo production after biphasic IVM
articles.title_cn: P128 双相体外成熟对马体外胚胎生产临床结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: Equine in vitro maturation (IVM) remains inefficient, with < 10% of retrieved oocytes resulting in a viable pregnancy. Biphasic IVM (temporary meiotic arrest before IVM) has been described in several species. A recent experimental study using slaughterhouse-derived equine oocytes and semen from a single stallion reported improved equine embryo development after biphasic IVM (Muhammad Fakhar et al. Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2025; 26:5495). The objective of this clinical case series was to evaluate whether temporary meiotic arrest before IVM could improve in vitro embryo production (IVP) after oocyte retrieval. Mares (n = 35) yielding at least 12 oocytes were included. From each mare, 3 sibling oocytes (n = 105) were randomly assigned to pre-IVM for 6, 12, or 24 h in CNP-supplemented medium after a 4–6 h holding period, whereas the remaining oocytes (n = 315) followed the routine clinical holding and IVM protocol. After maturation, all oocytes with a polar body underwent ICSI using semen from the same client-selected stallion within each case (15 stallions overall) and were cultured for 9 d in a time-lapse incubator. Outcomes assessed were maturation, cleavage, blastocyst development, and cleavage normality. Pre-IVM for 24 h was detrimental, reducing maturation to 40% and cleavage to 50%, and yielding no blastocysts (0%; P < 0.05). In contrast, pre-IVM for 6 and 12 h resulted in maturation (67.4–71.4%), cleavage (75.9–76.7%), and blastocyst (17.2–26.7%) rates similar to those observed with the routine clinical protocol (67.9%, 70.1%, and 23.4%, respectively; P > 0.05). Cleavage normality did not differ among groups (P = 0.1327). Under clinical conditions, short pre-IVM periods (6–12 h) did not improve IVP outcomes, whereas prolonged meiotic arrest (24 h) impaired development. Unlike the earlier single-stallion experimental report, this clinical case series did not demonstrate a benefit of biphasic IVM under routine clinical conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 马的体外成熟（IVM）效率仍然较低，回收的卵母细胞中仅有< 10%能够产生可存活的妊娠。双相IVM（在IVM前进行暂时的减数分裂阻滞）已在多个物种中有所描述。最近一项使用屠宰场来源的马卵母细胞和单一公马精液的实验研究报告称，双相IVM改善了马胚胎发育（Muhammad Fakhar等，Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2025；26：5495）。本临床病例系列研究的目的是评估在卵母细胞回收后，IVM前进行暂时的减数分裂阻滞是否能改善体外胚胎生产（IVP）。纳入产卵母细胞数至少为12个的母马（n = 35）。每匹母马的3个同源卵母细胞（n = 105）在4-6小时保持期后，随机分配到补充CNP的培养基中进行6、12或24小时的pre-IVM处理，而其余卵母细胞（n = 315）则遵循常规临床保持和IVM方案。成熟后，所有具有极体的卵母细胞使用每个病例中客户选择的同一公马的精液（共15匹公马）进行ICSI，并在时差培养箱中培养9天。评估的结果包括成熟率、卵裂率、囊胚发育率和卵裂正常性。pre-IVM 24小时处理是有害的，使成熟率降至40%，卵裂率降至50%，且未产生囊胚（0%；P < 0.05）。相比之下，pre-IVM 6和12小时处理的成熟率（67.4-71.4%）、卵裂率（75.9-76.7%）和囊胚率（17.2-26.7%）与常规临床方案观察到的结果相似（分别为67.9%、70.1%和23.4%；P > 0.05）。各组间的卵裂正常性无差异（P = 0.1327）。在临床条件下，短时间pre-IVM处理（6-12小时）并未改善IVP结局，而延长的减数分裂阻滞（24小时）则损害了发育。与早期单一公马的实验报告不同，本临床病例系列研究未显示双相IVM在常规临床条件下的益处。

articles.title_en: P131   Role of cryoprotectants and seminal plasma in the fertility of cooled-stored donkey (<ce:italic>Equus asinus</ce:italic>) semen
articles.title_cn: P131 冷冻保护剂和精浆在冷却储存的驴（<ce:italic>Equus asinus</ce:italic>）精液生育力中的作用
articles.abstract_en: Artificial insemination using cooled semen is widely applied in horses but remains poorly developed in donkeys. Strategies such as cholesterol supplementation, egg-yolk freezing extenders, and seminal plasma (SP) removal improve sperm preservation and fertility in mares. However, cryoprotectant exposure and absence of SP have been linked to reduced conception in jennies inseminated with frozen-thawed semen, raising uncertainty regarding their suitability for cooled semen. Therefore, this study compared processing protocols for cooled donkey semen and evaluated fertility in jennies. Four ejaculates from 7 jacks (n = 28) were diluted in a milk-based extender containing cholesterol (BotuSemen GoldⓇ; BG) or an egg-yolk extender with (BotuCrioⓇ; BC) or without permeable cryoprotectants (BCnC). A secondary experiment compared BG with centrifuged semen resuspended without SP (BG-SP). Semen was stored at 5°C for 72 h and evaluated for total (TM) and progressive motility (PM), rapid sperm (RAP) by CASA, and plasma membrane integrity (PMI), mitochondrial membrane potential (HMMP), and reactive oxygen species (ROS) by flow cytometry. In a crossover trial, 16 jennies (61 cycles) were inseminated with semen from 2 jacks cooled for 24 h (1 or 2 × 109 sperm) in BG, BC, BCnC, or BG-SP. Ovulation was induced with histrelin acetate (250 µg), and uterine cytology performed before and 6, 24, and 48 h post-AI. The TM, PM, RAP, and PMI were higher in BC and BCnC than BG at 24–72 h (P < 0.05). The HMMP did not differ (P > 0.05), whereas ROS was lower in BC and BCnC (P < 0.05). BG-SP improved TM and PM at all times and PMI and RAP at 72 h (P < 0.05). Fertility was unaffected by extender (BG 60% [9/15]; BC 60% [9/15]; BCnC 43.8% [7/16]; BG-SP 53.3% [8/15]) or in vitro sperm quality, and post-breeding inflammation was similar across groups (P > 0.05). A higher insemination dose tended to increase pregnancy probability (OR, 3.14; P = 0.06). In conclusion, neither cryoprotectant exposure nor SP removal influenced conception rates in jennies AI with cooled semen. Although BC, BCnC, and BG-SP improved in vitro sperm parameters, these differences did not translate into higher fertility, suggesting that conventional sperm quality metrics may not reliably predict reproductive outcomes in donkey AI. However, higher insemination doses may be beneficial for this species.
articles.abstract_cn: 使用冷却精液进行人工授精在马中广泛应用，但在驴中仍发展不足。胆固醇补充、蛋黄冷冻稀释液和精浆（SP）去除等策略可改善母马的精子保存和生育力。然而，冷冻保护剂暴露和缺乏SP与使用冷冻-解冻精液授精的母驴受孕率降低有关，这引发了对其适用于冷却精液的疑虑。因此，本研究比较了冷却驴精液的处理方案，并评估了母驴的生育力。从7头公驴（n = 28）采集的四次射精，分别用含胆固醇的牛奶基础稀释液（BotuSemen GoldⓇ；BG）或含蛋黄稀释液（BotuCrioⓇ；BC）或不含可渗透冷冻保护剂的蛋黄稀释液（BCnC）进行稀释。第二个实验比较了BG与离心后去除SP重悬的精液（BG-SP）。精液在5°C下储存72小时，并通过CASA评估总活力（TM）和前进活力（PM）、快速精子（RAP），以及通过流式细胞术评估质膜完整性（PMI）、线粒体膜电位（HMMP）和活性氧（ROS）。在一项交叉试验中，16头母驴（61个周期）使用来自2头公驴冷却24小时的精液（1或2 × 109精子）在BG、BC、BCnC或BG-SP中进行授精。使用醋酸组氨瑞林（250 µg）诱导排卵，并在授精前及授精后6、24和48小时进行子宫细胞学检查。在24-72小时，BC和BCnC的TM、PM、RAP和PMI高于BG（P < 0.05）。HMMP无差异（P > 0.05），而BC和BCnC的ROS较低（P < 0.05）。BG-SP在所有时间点改善了TM和PM，并在72小时改善了PMI和RAP（P < 0.05）。生育力不受稀释液（BG 60% [9/15]；BC 60% [9/15]；BCnC 43.8% [7/16]；BG-SP 53.3% [8/15]）或体外精子质量的影响，授精后炎症在各组间相似（P > 0.05）。较高的授精剂量倾向于增加妊娠概率（OR，3.14；P = 0.06）。总之，冷冻保护剂暴露或SP去除均不影响使用冷却精液进行AI的母驴受孕率。尽管BC、BCnC和BG-SP改善了体外精子参数，但这些差异并未转化为更高的生育力，表明常规精子质量指标可能无法可靠预测驴AI的繁殖结果。然而，较高的授精剂量可能对该物种有益。

articles.title_en: P132   Systemic oxidative stress in platelet-rich plasma from embryo donor mares with endometritis: Implications for autologous PRP therapy
articles.title_cn: P132 患有子宫内膜炎的胚胎供体母马富血小板血浆中的系统性氧化应激：对自体富血小板血浆治疗的意义
articles.abstract_en: Platelet-rich plasma (PRP), rich in growth factors that promote angiogenesis and tissue repair, is widely used to treat endometritis in mares. The goal of PRP treatment is to reduce post-breeding uterine inflammation; however, systemic inflammation may compromise autologous PRP quality. This study aimed to evaluate systemic oxidative stress in PRP from embryo donor mares with endometritis. Twenty-one cycles from 20 healthy crossbred mares were distributed into 2 groups: Control (n = 10) and Endometritis (n = 11; intrauterine fluid accumulation). All mares had low-volume uterine lavage fluid collected 24 h before (T1) and 24 h after (T2) artificial insemination (AI), and venous blood collected every 6 h from the time of AI (5 time points). Mares diagnosed with endometritis were treated with oxytocin (10 IU, IV) and therapeutic uterine lavage with lactated Ringer’s solution either after uterine fluid sample collection or immediately before AI. PRP was collected for oxidative stress analysis and was not infused. All mares had uterine flush for embryo recovery performed on d 8–9 post-ovulation. Oxidative stress (levels of reactive oxygen species, ROS) was assessed by the thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS) assay in PRP and low-volume uterine lavage fluid. Blood serum amyloid A (SAA) was measured by fluorescent immunoassay. Data were analyzed using generalized linear models for repeated measures with Bonferroni adjustment. Endometritis mares were older (21.8 ± 6.0 yr) than controls (14.2 ± 7.9 yr). The PRP ROS were higher in Endometritis versus Control at T1 (0.071 ± 0.009 vs. 0.033 ± 0.005 ng/mL; P = 0.002) and T2 (0.057 ± 0.008 vs. 0.022 ± 0.003 ng/mL; P < 0.001), with no within-group differences over time. The SAA remained < 0.5 µg/mL in all serum samples. The ROS in low-volume uterine lavage did not differ between groups. Embryo recovery was higher in Controls (6/10; 60%) versus Endometritis (2/11; 18.2%). These findings suggest that endometritis induces systemic oxidative stress detectable in PRP despite unchanged acute-phase serum markers; however the effect of advanced mare age could not be separated out. Elevated PRP ROS in older affected mares warrants further work to evaluate whether heterologous PRP from young healthy donors may offer greater therapeutic efficacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 富血小板血浆（PRP）富含促进血管生成和组织修复的生长因子，广泛用于治疗母马子宫内膜炎。PRP治疗的目标是减少配种后的子宫炎症；然而，系统性炎症可能损害自体PRP的质量。本研究旨在评估患有子宫内膜炎的胚胎供体母马PRP中的系统性氧化应激。来自20匹健康杂交母马的二十一个周期被分为2组：对照组（n = 10）和子宫内膜炎组（n = 11；宫内液体积聚）。所有母马在人工授精（AI）前24小时（T1）和AI后24小时（T2）收集低容量子宫灌洗液，并从AI时起每6小时收集静脉血（5个时间点）。诊断为子宫内膜炎的母马在子宫液样本采集后或AI前立即接受催产素（10 IU，静脉注射）和乳酸林格氏液治疗性子宫灌洗。PRP采集用于氧化应激分析，未进行输注。所有母马在排卵后第8-9天进行子宫冲洗以回收胚胎。通过硫代巴比妥酸反应物质（TBARS）测定法评估PRP和低容量子宫灌洗液中的氧化应激（活性氧物种，ROS水平）。通过荧光免疫测定法测量血清淀粉样蛋白A（SAA）。数据使用广义线性模型进行重复测量分析，并采用Bonferroni校正。子宫内膜炎母马年龄较大（21.8 ± 6.0岁），而对照组为（14.2 ± 7.9岁）。在T1（0.071 ± 0.009 vs. 0.033 ± 0.005 ng/mL；P = 0.002）和T2（0.057 ± 0.008 vs. 0.022 ± 0.003 ng/mL；P < 0.001）时，子宫内膜炎组的PRP ROS高于对照组，组内随时间无差异。所有血清样本中SAA保持< 0.5 µg/mL。低容量子宫灌洗液中的ROS在组间无差异。胚胎回收率在对照组（6/10；60%）高于子宫内膜炎组（2/11；18.2%）。这些发现表明，尽管急性期血清标志物未改变，子宫内膜炎可诱导PRP中可检测的系统性氧化应激；然而，母马年龄增长的影响无法分离。老年患病母马中PRP ROS升高，需要进一步研究以评估来自年轻健康供体的异体PRP是否可能提供更大的治疗效果。

articles.title_en: P133   Temporal dynamics of uterine bacterial load in mares: A crossover comparison of antibiotic and antibiotic-free artificial insemination
articles.title_cn: 母马子宫细菌载量的时间动态：抗生素与无抗生素人工授精的交叉比较
articles.abstract_en: Current information on estrous cycle–associated variations in the equine reproductive tract microbiota is scarce. Our aim was to investigate changes in the uterine bacterial load of estrous mares after insemination when semen was processed with or without antibiotics (AB). Adult healthy mares (n = 9) were monitored over 4 consecutive estrous cycles. Double-guarded endometrial swabs were collected at 4 time points: (1) beginning of estrus (progesterone < 2 ng/mL, low–moderate endometrial edema, follicle(s) = 28 mm), (2) peak estrus (strong endometrial edema, preovulatory follicle = 35 mm), (3) end of estrus (36 h after injection of 1,500 IU hCG), (4) 10 d after ovulation when an embryo collection was done. Mares were left uninseminated in the control cycle. They were inseminated in 2 cycles separated by one resting cycle. Insemination was performed 24 h after hCG with fresh semen diluted with Equiplus (Minitube) extender with AB (penicillin plus amikacin; cycle AB) or without AB (cycle NAB) in a cross over design. Endometrial samples were cultured on (i) Columbia Blood agar (incubated under aerobic and anaerobic conditions) (ii) MacConkey II agar, and (iii) Columbia CNA Blood agar. Colony-forming units (cfu) were counted 48 h after incubation at 37°C. Single colonies were identified using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry (Bruker). Out of 416 plates, 291 (70%) yielded no growth. Corynebacterium spp. and Streptococcus spp. were the most frequently isolated microorganisms (19/108 samples each). The cfu/mL among cycles and different time points were analyzed using a general linear model for repeated measures. There was a reduction in cfu count from time 2 to 4 with Columbia Blood agar (anaerobic) and Columbia CNA (both P < 0.05) irrespective of the cycle. There were no differences in cfu count among cycles or over time. Embryo collection rate did not differ among insemination cycles (AB cycle: 6/9, NAB cycle 7/9). These findings suggest that AB in the semen extender do not result in considerable changes of the endometrial bacterial load in healthy mares.
articles.abstract_cn: 目前关于发情周期相关变化对马生殖道微生物群影响的信息很少。我们的目的是研究当精液使用含或不含抗生素（AB）处理时，发情母马授精后子宫细菌载量的变化。成年健康母马（n = 9）在连续4个发情周期内进行监测。在4个时间点采集双保护子宫内膜拭子：（1）发情开始（孕酮 < 2 ng/mL，低至中度子宫内膜水肿，卵泡 = 28 mm），（2）发情高峰（强烈子宫内膜水肿，排卵前卵泡 = 35 mm），（3）发情结束（注射1,500 IU hCG后36 h），（4）排卵后10 d，此时进行胚胎收集。母马在对照周期不进行授精。它们在2个周期中进行授精，中间间隔一个休息周期。授精在hCG后24 h进行，使用新鲜精液，以交叉设计方式，用含AB（青霉素加阿米卡星；AB周期）或不含AB（NAB周期）的Equiplus（Minitube）稀释液稀释。子宫内膜样本在（i）哥伦比亚血琼脂（在需氧和厌氧条件下培养）、（ii）麦康凯II琼脂和（iii）哥伦比亚CNA血琼脂上培养。在37°C孵育48 h后计数菌落形成单位（cfu）。使用MALDI-TOF质谱（Bruker）鉴定单个菌落。在416个平板中，291个（70%%）无生长。棒状杆菌属和链球菌属是最常分离的微生物（各19/108个样本）。使用重复测量的一般线性模型分析各周期和不同时间点的cfu/mL。从时间2到4，哥伦比亚血琼脂（厌氧）和哥伦比亚CNA的cfu计数减少（均P < 0.05），与周期无关。各周期之间或随时间变化，cfu计数无差异。胚胎收集率在授精周期之间无差异（AB周期：6/9，NAB周期7/9）。这些发现表明，精液稀释液中的AB不会导致健康母马子宫内膜细菌载量的显著变化。

articles.title_en: P134   Effects of post-thawing transport and donor mare age on pregnancy outcomes of vitrified IVP equine embryos produced in a commercial ICSI laboratory
articles.title_cn: P134 解冻后运输和供体母马年龄对商业ICSI实验室生产的玻璃化IVP马胚胎妊娠结局的影响
articles.abstract_en: Pregnancy rates following transfer of in vitro-produced (IVP) equine embryos are influenced by donor, recipient, stallion, and embryo quality. However, factors affecting post-thaw viability and pregnancy outcomes particularly after transport, are poorly defined. This retrospective study analyzed post-thaw early pregnancy outcomes of IVP blastocysts produced via intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) in a commercial laboratory. A total of 51 blastocysts from 32 donors were vitrified at d 6–9 of development using CryotechⓇ vit-kit. Donors were classified as Group A (2–14 years, n = 18) or Group B (15–21 years, n = 14). Embryos were thawed either at the embryo transfer center (ETC) or at the laboratory followed by transport, under controlled conditions at a temperature of 25°C for up to 5 h. Embryos were classified into 2 groups: thawed at the ETC and thawed at the laboratory followed by transport to the ETC. Pregnancy diagnosis was performed 7 d after ET and at 60 d of pregnancy. Embryo thawing and transfer were each performed by a single experienced veterinarian, minimizing operator variability. The overall pregnancy rate at d 15 was 68.6% (35/51). Thawed-transported embryos had higher early pregnancy rates compared with thawed at the ETC (81.8%, 18/22 vs. 58.6%, 17/29; P ∼0.018). This finding was irrespective of donor mare age, with pregnancy rates for Group A of 76.9% (10/13) for thawed-transported embryos versus 53.3% (8/15) without transport, and for Group B 88.9% (8/9) versus 64.3% (9/14), respectively. Pregnancy rates at d 60 were similar for Group A (57.1%, 16/28) and B (47.8%, 11/23) donors, but pregnancy loss between d 15 and 60 was higher for Group B (35.3%, 6/17) compared with Group A (11.1%, 2/18). Data analyzed with chi-squared test. Results indicate that CryotechⓇ medium supports high viability and pregnancy rates for vitrified IVP embryos. Moreover, embryos can be safely transported under controlled conditions without compromising early pregnancy. Regarding donor mare age, Group B tended to show increased pregnancy loss. To our knowledge, this is the first study showing that post-thaw IVP embryos can be safely transported for up to 5 h at 25°C while maintaining high viability and pregnancy rates, supporting their use in commercial ET programs.
articles.abstract_cn: 体外生产（IVP）马胚胎移植后的妊娠率受供体、受体、公马和胚胎质量的影响。然而，影响解冻后存活率和妊娠结局的因素，特别是在运输后，尚不明确。本回顾性研究分析了在商业实验室通过胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）生产的IVP囊胚解冻后的早期妊娠结局。共有来自32匹供体的51个囊胚在发育第6-9天使用CryotechⓇ玻璃化试剂盒进行玻璃化。供体分为A组（2-14岁，n = 18）和B组（15-21岁，n = 14）。胚胎在胚胎移植中心（ETC）解冻或在实验室解冻后运输，在受控条件下于25°C温度下运输长达5小时。胚胎分为2组：在ETC解冻和在实验室解冻后运输至ETC。妊娠诊断在胚胎移植后7天和妊娠60天进行。胚胎解冻和移植均由一名经验丰富的兽医执行，以最小化操作者变异。第15天的总体妊娠率为68.6%（35/51）。解冻后运输的胚胎早期妊娠率高于在ETC解冻的胚胎（81.8%，18/22对比58.6%，17/29；P ∼0.018）。这一发现与供体母马年龄无关，A组解冻后运输的胚胎妊娠率为76.9%（10/13），而未运输的为53.3%（8/15）；B组分别为88.9%（8/9）和64.3%（9/14）。第60天的妊娠率在A组（57.1%，16/28）和B组（47.8%，11/23）供体之间相似，但第15天至第60天之间的妊娠丢失率B组（35.3%，6/17）高于A组（11.1%，2/18）。数据采用卡方检验分析。结果表明，CryotechⓇ培养基支持玻璃化IVP胚胎的高存活率和妊娠率。此外，胚胎可以在受控条件下安全运输，而不影响早期妊娠。关于供体母马年龄，B组倾向于表现出更高的妊娠丢失率。据我们所知，这是第一项研究表明解冻后的IVP胚胎可以在25°C下安全运输长达5小时，同时保持高存活率和妊娠率，支持其在商业胚胎移植项目中的应用。

articles.title_en: P138   Plasma concentrations of altrenogest following intramuscular administration of a compounded altrenogest product in the mare
articles.title_cn: 母马肌肉注射复方阿替诺孕酮产品后血浆中阿替诺孕酮的浓度
articles.abstract_en: Plasma concentrations of altrenogest following intramuscular administration of a compounded altrenogest product in the mare Altrenogest is a synthetic progestin utilized in equine breeding management for estrus suppression and maintenance of pregnancy. Progestin support is necessary for maintenance of pregnancy in hormone-treated non-cycling recipient mares. The goal of this study was to evaluate plasma concentrations of altrenogest following intramuscular administration of a compounded altrenogest product (Altrenogest 225 mg/mL injection, Doc Lane’s Veterinary Pharmacy, Lexington, KY, USA). In vitro equine progesterone receptor bioassays have shown that altrenogest and natural progesterone are approximately equipotent. The minimum plasma progesterone concentration required for maintenance of pregnancy in early gestation mares has been suggested to be 4.0 ng/mL. Five Quarter Horse mares were weighed and administered a single intramuscular dose of 0.5 mg/kg of the compounded altrenogest. A jugular venous blood sample was collected into a heparinized vacutainer tube immediately before altrenogest administration. Additional blood samples were obtained at 8 h and at 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 d after administration. Samples were centrifuged and the plasma harvested, transferred into labeled sterile plastic storage vials and frozen at −20°C until assayed for altrenogest concentration by a validated HPLC-MS. Plasma levels were 12.9 ± 4.1 ng/mL (mean ± SEM) at 8 h post-treatment and decreased progressively over time. One-way ANOVA showed that a significant rise from baseline was sustained from 8 h until d 6. Mean plasma concentration of altrenogest was 3.9 ± 0.3 ng/mL at d 6 post-treatment and remained > 1.0 ng/mL throughout the 12-d observation period. Data from the current study indicate that administration of this compounded injectable altrenogest at 0.5 mg/kg should be repeated at approximately 6-d intervals to maintain plasma concentrations near or above 4 ng/mL in mares in which exogenous altrenogest is the only form of progestin support. In addition, the washout period after intramuscular administration was determined to be greater than 12 d.
articles.abstract_cn: 母马肌肉注射复方阿替诺孕酮产品后血浆中阿替诺孕酮的浓度 阿替诺孕酮是一种合成孕激素，用于马匹繁殖管理中的发情抑制和妊娠维持。对于激素处理的非周期受体母马，孕激素支持是维持妊娠所必需的。本研究旨在评估肌肉注射复方阿替诺孕酮产品（阿替诺孕酮225 mg/mL注射液，Doc Lane兽医药店，美国肯塔基州列克星敦）后血浆中阿替诺孕酮的浓度。体外马孕酮受体生物测定显示，阿替诺孕酮和天然孕酮大约等效。早期妊娠母马维持妊娠所需的最低血浆孕酮浓度被建议为4.0 ng/mL。五匹夸特马母马被称重并单次肌肉注射0.5 mg/kg的复方阿替诺孕酮。在给药前立即将颈静脉血样采集到肝素化真空采血管中。给药后8小时及1、2、4、6、8、10和12天分别采集额外血样。样品离心后收集血浆，转移到标记的无菌塑料储存瓶中，并在−20°C冷冻，直至通过验证的HPLC-MS测定阿替诺孕酮浓度。治疗后8小时血浆水平为12.9 ± 4.1 ng/mL（平均值±标准误），并随时间逐渐下降。单因素方差分析显示，从8小时至第6天，与基线相比有显著升高。治疗后第6天平均血浆阿替诺孕酮浓度为3.9 ± 0.3 ng/mL，并在整个12天观察期内保持>1.0 ng/mL。本研究数据表明，对于外源性阿替诺孕酮作为唯一孕激素支持的母马，以0.5 mg/kg剂量注射该复方注射用阿替诺孕酮应大约每6天重复一次，以维持血浆浓度接近或高于4 ng/mL。此外，肌肉注射后的洗脱期被确定为大于12天。

articles.title_en: P140   Efficacy of ozone therapy versus platelet-rich plasma in mares with endometritis
articles.abstract_en: Endometritis is considered one of the main causes of reproductive failure in mares, with prevalence ranging from 25% to 60% among animals unable to establish pregnancy. The limited efficacy of conventional therapies and growing antimicrobial resistance have encouraged the use of alternative treatments. Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) has gained attention due to its anti-inflammatory, regenerative, and antimicrobial properties, whereas ozone therapy is characterized by anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and angiogenic effects, simple application, and low incidence of adverse reactions. This study compared the efficacy of PRP and ozone (O3) therapies in the treatment of equine endometritis. Thirty-six mares, aged 4 to 22 years, were evaluated by transrectal ultrasonography, and uterine samples were collected for bacterial and fungal culture and cytology. Endometritis was diagnosed based on positive bacterial and/or fungal culture from uterine samples; endometrial cytology was used to determine the presence of polymorphonuclear neutrophils (PMN) as an indicator of uterine inflammation. After diagnosis, mares were allocated into 3 groups: G1 (n = 16), intrauterine infusion of 1 L ozonated lactated Ringer’s solution (50 µg O3 for 10 min); G2 (n = 10), intrauterine insufflation of ozone gas without carrier solution (40 µg O3 for 5 min); and G3 (n = 10), intrauterine infusion of 25–40 mL of PRP. Treatments were performed during estrus, and mares were inseminated with fresh semen 24 h later. Data were analyzed using the chi-squared (χ2) test (SPSS 29.0). All mares presented positive uterine culture before treatment. Bacterial infection, mixed infection (bacterial and fungal), and cytological evidence of inflammation (PMN) were recorded as follows: G1 = 8, 8, and 10; G2 = 4, 6, and 4; and G3 = 6, 4, and 6. Pregnancy rates after treatment for bacterial, mixed, and cytological endometritis were 87.5%, 75%, and 90% in G1; 100%, 66.6%, and 75% in G2; and 0%, 25%, and 50% in G3, respectively. Groups G1 and G2 showed significantly better outcomes than G3 (P < 0.05). Overall pregnancy rates were 81%, 80%, and 10% for G1, G2, and G3, respectively. These findings suggest that ozone therapy may be more effective than PRP in improving pregnancy outcomes in mares with culture-positive endometritis.

articles.title_en: P143   Estradiol cypionate enhances placental histomorphometry in mares with ascending placentitis
articles.title_cn: P143 环戊丙酸雌二醇增强上行性胎盘炎母马的胎盘组织形态计量学
articles.abstract_en: This study compared the effects of estradiol cypionate (ECP) and altrenogest (ALT) treatments on placental efficiency in mares with experimentally induced ascending placentitis. Criollo mares were assigned to groups: healthy controls (n = 5), ECP treatment (n = 5), and ALT treatment (n = 5). Placentitis was induced in ECP and ALT mares by inoculation of 107 cfu of S. equi zooepidemicus, at 300 d of gestation. Treatment began 48 h after experimental induction of placentitis and mares received trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole and flunixin meglumine with their respective hormonal therapy for 10 d. Chorioallantoic samples from 4 regions were collected and analyzed using digital pathology to quantify microcotyledonary and capillary areas. Gestation length (days) differed among groups (P = 0.026), with ECP-treated mares (345 ± 11) showing longer gestation than ALT mares (322 ± 10), whereas controls showed intermediate values (336 ± 13). Histomorphometric analysis showed significant treatment effects on placental vascularization (P < 0.001), with ECP group showing greater capillary area than ALT group. Additionally, the interaction between anatomical location and experimental group (P < 0.001) showed hormonal treatment effects on microcotyledonary area varied by placental region. The ECP group showed superior preservation of microcotyledonary architecture in metabolically active regions—gravid horn (5.04 × 106 µm2) and non-gravid horn (4.99 × 106 µm2)—maintaining values comparable to healthy controls. In contrast, the ALT group showed pronounced reduction, especially in the non-gravid horn region (4.01 × 106 µm2). This pattern may reflect differences in gestational duration among groups, as preterm delivery is commonly associated with reduced microcotyledonary development in the uterine horns. Neonatal outcomes varied significantly, with foal birth weight (kg) substantially reduced in the ALT group (29 ± 5) compared with controls (39 ± 6) and ECP mares (36 ± 2). The placental-to-foal weight ratio was significantly elevated in the ALT group (20 ± 3), indicating compromised placental efficiency compared with controls (11 ± 1) and ECP group (13 ± 2). These findings show that ECP maintains gestation length, preserves placental structure and vascularization, and improves neonatal viability in mares with ascending placentitis, outperforming altrenogest therapy in maintaining feto-placental homeostasis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究比较了环戊丙酸雌二醇（ECP）和烯丙孕素（ALT）治疗对实验性诱导上行性胎盘炎母马胎盘效率的影响。克里奥罗母马被分为以下各组：健康对照组（n = 5）、ECP治疗组（n = 5）和ALT治疗组（n = 5）。通过接种107 cfu的兽疫链球菌在妊娠300天诱导ECP和ALT母马发生胎盘炎。治疗在实验性诱导胎盘炎后48小时开始，母马接受甲氧苄啶-磺胺甲恶唑和氟尼辛葡甲胺以及各自的激素治疗，持续10天。从4个区域采集绒毛膜尿囊样本，并使用数字病理学分析以量化微绒毛叶和毛细血管面积。妊娠时长（天）在各组间存在差异（P = 0.026），ECP治疗母马（345 ± 11）的妊娠时长长于ALT母马（322 ± 10），而对照组显示中间值（336 ± 13）。组织形态计量学分析显示治疗对胎盘血管化有显著影响（P < 0.001），ECP组的毛细血管面积大于ALT组。此外，解剖位置与实验组之间的交互作用（P < 0.001）显示激素治疗对微绒毛叶面积的影响因胎盘区域而异。ECP组在代谢活跃区域——孕角（5.04 × 106 µm2）和非孕角（4.99 × 106 µm2）——显示出微绒毛叶结构的优越保留，维持了与健康对照组相当的值。相比之下，ALT组显示出显著减少，尤其是在非孕角区域（4.01 × 106 µm2）。这种模式可能反映了各组间妊娠时长的差异，因为早产通常与子宫角微绒毛叶发育减少相关。新生儿结局差异显著，ALT组的马驹出生体重（kg）大幅降低（29 ± 5），而对照组为（39 ± 6），ECP母马为（36 ± 2）。ALT组的胎盘与马驹体重比显著升高（20 ± 3），表明与对照组（11 ± 1）和ECP组（13 ± 2）相比，胎盘效率受损。这些发现表明，ECP维持妊娠时长、保留胎盘结构和血管化，并改善上行性胎盘炎母马的新生儿存活能力，在维持胎儿-胎盘稳态方面优于烯丙孕素治疗。

articles.title_en: P144   Hormonal modulation affects endometrial miRNA levels in mares
articles.title_cn: 激素调节影响母马子宫内膜miRNA水平
articles.abstract_en: Longer endometrial exposure to estradiol before progesterone has been associated with improved fertility in both cyclic and acyclic mares [Cuervo-Arango et al. (Equine Vet. J. 2018; 50:386–390); Silva et al. (Theriogenology 2024; 226:1–9)]. Modulation of the uterine environment is essential for establishing embryo receptivity, and extracellular vesicles (EV) play a key role in cellular communication through their molecular cargo. Previous studies indicate that sexual steroids can regulate this molecular composition [Hart et al. (Biomolecules 2023; 13:279)]. Given the regulatory importance of microRNAs (miRNAs) present in EV, this study aimed to identify differentially expressed miRNAs in uterine samples from mares subjected to varying estradiol exposures before progesterone rise. Three groups were established: Long Estrus (LE, n = 11), Short Estrus (SE, n = 11), and No Estrus (NE, n = 6). Acyclic mares assigned to LE and SE received a single 10 mg intramuscular estradiol cypionate dose 7 or 2 d, respectively, before 1,500 mg of long-acting progesterone (LA P4). The NE mares only received LA P4. Additional cycles were later included in LE and SE based on natural estrus duration along the breeding season (= 6 d or < 3 d). Four days after LA P4 administration or ovulation, uterine fluid samples were collected via low-volume lavage (60 mL dmPBS) and tissue samples via endometrial biopsy. The EV were isolated by ultracentrifugation and characterized using flow cytometry and nanoparticle tracking analysis. A wide panel of equine miRNAs was initially screened in pooled samples through RT-qPCR, and those showing variation among groups were subsequently analyzed individually. Relative expression comparisons revealed that EV-associated eca-miR-30d (P < 0.05) and eca-miR-106b (P < 0.05) was increased in NE compared with LE and SE. Differently, in endometrial tissue, eca-miR-23a showed a progressive decrease from LE to SE to NE (P < 0.0001). Also, miR-32 was upregulated in LE versus both SE and NE (P < 0.0001). Conversely, miR-9a was downregulated in LE compared with SE and NE (P < 0.001). Thus, differential estradiol exposure was able to modulate miRNA levels in mares, within uterine EV and endometrium. This data contributes to elucidating how estrus duration may influence fertility through the investigation of uterine molecular regulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 在母马中，无论是周期性还是非周期性，孕酮之前较长时间的子宫内膜暴露于雌二醇与提高生育力相关[Cuervo-Arango等（Equine Vet. J. 2018; 50: 386-390）；Silva等（Theriogenology 2024; 226: 1-9）]。子宫环境的调节对于建立胚胎接受性至关重要，而细胞外囊泡（EV）通过其分子货物在细胞通讯中发挥关键作用。先前的研究表明，性类固醇可以调节这种分子组成[Hart等（Biomolecules 2023; 13: 279）]。鉴于EV中存在的microRNAs（miRNAs）的调节重要性，本研究旨在鉴定在孕酮升高前接受不同雌二醇暴露的母马子宫样本中差异表达的miRNAs。设立了三个组：长发情期（LE，n = 11）、短发情期（SE，n = 11）和无发情期（NE，n = 6）。分配给LE和SE的无周期母马分别在长效孕酮（LA P4）10 mg前7天或2天接受单次1,500 mg肌肉注射雌二醇环戊丙酸酯。NE母马仅接受LA P4。随后，根据繁殖季节期间自然发情持续时间（= 6天或< 3天），在LE和SE中纳入了额外的周期。在LA P4给药或排卵后四天，通过低容量灌洗（60 mL dmPBS）收集子宫液样本，并通过子宫内膜活检收集组织样本。通过超速离心分离EV，并使用流式细胞术和纳米颗粒跟踪分析进行表征。通过RT-qPCR在合并样本中初步筛选了广泛的马miRNA面板，随后对组间显示变异的那些进行单独分析。相对表达比较显示，与LE和SE相比，NE中EV相关的eca-miR-30d（P < 0.05）和eca-miR-106b（P < 0.05）增加。不同地，在子宫内膜组织中，eca-miR-23a从LE到SE到NE呈进行性下降（P < 0.0001）。此外，miR-32在LE中相对于SE和NE上调（P < 0.0001）。相反，miR-9a在LE中相对于SE和NE下调（P < 0.001）。因此，不同的雌二醇暴露能够调节母马子宫EV和子宫内膜中的miRNA水平。这些数据有助于通过研究子宫分子调节来阐明发情持续时间如何影响生育力。

articles.title_en: P145   Uterine microbiome in fertile and subfertile Colombian Creole mares
articles.title_cn: P145 可育与亚不育哥伦比亚克里奥尔母马的子宫微生物组
articles.abstract_en: Endometritis is the most common cause of subfertility in horses. Traditional diagnostics suffer from limited sensitivity and often fail to detect the full spectrum of uterine microorganisms. Health of the uterus in mares, converts into a produced embryo or a healthy pregnancy in the recipient mare. The aim of this study was to evaluate the association between Colombian Creole mares classified as resistant (R) or susceptible (S) with the presence of microorganisms obtained through conventional methods and the use of genetic sequencing techniques to identify the uterine microbiome. A total of 29 mares, located in Antioquia, Colombia, were used. To allocate each mare into the R or S group, a breeding soundness examination (BSE) was performed. Endometrial cytology was conducted from swab-derived samples; microbiological culture, from uterine low-volume lavage and biopsy, histopathology analysis from endometrial biopsy and DNA Extraction from endometrial biopsy and low-volume lavage. The V3–V4 hypervariable regions of the 16S rRNA gene were sequenced. Bioinformatic processing and taxonomic assignment were performed using QIIME 2 and microbial biomarkers were identified through discriminant analysis. Statistical analyses were performed using Student’s t-test for means comparison and χ2 tests for molecular data. Nineteen mares (65.5%) were categorized into group R and 10 (34.4%) into group S. In Group R, 36.8% of the mares tested positive for both cytology and culture, while in Group S, 70% were positive for cytology and 100% for culture. In group R, the most frequently isolated microorganisms were E. coli (21.05%) and Staphylococcus spp. (10.5%); for group S, Candida spp. (40%), Klebsiella spp. (20%), and Staphylococcus spp. (20%). Regarding the uterine biopsy, the results obtained for group R versus group S were 26.3% and 11.1% for Category I, 36.8% and 55.5% for Category IIa, and 36.8% and 33.3% for Category IIb, respectively. Significant differences in β-diversity were observed, with lower values in R compared with S mares, and discriminant analysis identified Anaerococcus and Corynebacterium as indicators of S mares. In conclusion, DNA sequencing seems to offer new opportunities to unravel microbial dysbiosis associated with endometritis in mares, improving the understanding of its pathogenesis and potentially guiding more precise diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 子宫内膜炎是母马亚不育的最常见原因。传统诊断方法敏感性有限，往往无法检测出全部子宫微生物谱。母马子宫的健康状况，转化为受体母马中产生的胚胎或健康妊娠。本研究旨在评估被分类为抵抗型（R）或易感型（S）的哥伦比亚克里奥尔母马与通过传统方法获得的微生物存在之间的关联，并利用基因测序技术鉴定子宫微生物组。共使用29匹母马，位于哥伦比亚安蒂奥基亚省。为将每匹母马分配到R或S组，进行了繁殖健全性检查（BSE）。对拭子来源的样本进行子宫内膜细胞学检查；对子宫低容量灌洗和活检样本进行微生物培养；对子宫内膜活检进行组织病理学分析；并从子宫内膜活检和低容量灌洗中提取DNA。对16 rRNA基因的V3–V4高变区进行测序。使用QIIME 2进行生物信息学处理和分类学分配，并通过判别分析识别微生物生物标志物。统计分析采用学生t检验进行均值比较，分子数据采用χ2检验。十九匹母马（65.5%）被归类为R组，10匹（34.4%）被归类为S组。在R组中，36.8%的母马细胞学和培养均呈阳性，而在S组中，70%细胞学阳性，100%培养阳性。在R组中，最常分离的微生物是大肠杆菌（21.05%）和葡萄球菌属（10.5%）；在S组中，念珠菌属（40%）、克雷伯菌属（20%）和葡萄球菌属（20%）。关于子宫活检，R组与S组的结果分别为：I类26.3%和11.1%，IIa类36.8%和55.5%，IIb类36.8%和33.3%。观察到β多样性的显著差异，R组的值低于S组，判别分析确定厌氧球菌属和棒状杆菌属为S组的指示菌。总之，DNA测序似乎为揭示与母马子宫内膜炎相关的微生物失调提供了新机会，增进了对其发病机制的理解，并可能指导更精确的诊断和治疗策略。

articles.title_en: A tension measurement method for prestressed steel strands via UGW propagating in peripheral wires
articles.title_cn: 一种通过外围钢丝中的超声导波测量预应力钢绞线张力的方法
articles.abstract_en: The tension level in prestressed steel strands is a critical factor determining the crack resistance and long-term durability of bridge structures. However, the complex geometric configuration of these strands, coupled with their embedded integration within concrete, poses significant challenges for effective tension measurement. Although ultrasonic guided wave (UGW) based methods offer reliable results by relying solely on the intrinsic mechanical properties of the material, research on their application to complex structures like steel strands remains insufficient, and a tailored measurement methodology is still lacking. Addressing practical engineering requirements, this study proposes a lateral excitation and reception method for UGW specifically targeting the outer wires of steel strands. The mechanical model of a single peripheral wire is analyzed, and a dispersion and multimodality analysis method that accounts for the inter-wire contact (squeezing) effect is developed. On this basis, a specialized nonlinear acoustoelastic model is established. Experimental results validate the accuracy of the proposed method and demonstrate the influence of propagation distance on the measurement outcomes. This research provides a novel paradigm for the tension assessment of steel strands in in-service bridges.
articles.abstract_cn: 预应力钢绞线的张力水平是决定桥梁结构抗裂性和长期耐久性的关键因素。然而，这些钢绞线的复杂几何构型，加上其在混凝土中的嵌入集成，对有效的张力测量构成了重大挑战。尽管基于超声导波（UGW）的方法仅依靠材料的固有机械性能即可提供可靠结果，但对其在钢绞线等复杂结构上的应用研究仍不足，且缺乏量身定制的测量方法。针对实际工程需求，本研究提出了一种针对钢绞线外层钢丝的横向激励和接收UGW方法。分析了单根外围钢丝的力学模型，并开发了一种考虑线间接触（挤压）效应的频散和多模态分析方法。在此基础上，建立了一个专门的非线性声弹性模型。实验结果验证了所提方法的准确性，并展示了传播距离对测量结果的影响。这项研究为在役桥梁中钢绞线的张力评估提供了一种新的范式。

articles.title_en: Prediction of residual stress and hybrid layer location for additively manufactured samples using ultrasonic spectroscopy and machine learning
articles.title_cn: 利用超声光谱和机器学习预测增材制造样品的残余应力及混合层位置
articles.abstract_en: Current methods for measuring residual stress in additively manufactured components face limitations in sensitivity or are destructive. Resonant ultrasound spectroscopy (RUS) offers a promising approach for assessing residual stresses in hybrid additively manufactured components. Hybrid additive manufacturing (AM) involves using secondary energy sources or processes to create functionally graded components at specific locations. Each hybrid layer or step refines grain size, increases dislocation density, and consequently alters residual stresses. This study employs finite element models to simulate residual stress in hybrid AM components. Using machine learning (ML), we predict both stress levels and the location of hybrid layers. A total of 1000 simulations generated a sufficiently large dataset for ML models. Partial least squares regression (PLSR) predicts residual stress with a mean absolute error (MAE) of approximately 3 MPa, which is less than 1% of residual stresses found in hybrid AM layers. Simultaneously, the location of the hybrid layer exhibits degeneracies in the resonant modes, necessitating a more robust algorithm. The ML models are able to predict the location of a hybrid layer within 0.14 mm using 80% of the data as a training set. This work lays the groundwork for future noninvasive and nondestructive measurements of residual stresses through experimental RUS combined with finite element modeling and machine learning.
