articles.abstract_cn: 当前测量增材制造部件残余应力的方法在灵敏度上存在局限或具有破坏性。共振超声光谱（RUS）为评估混合增材制造部件中的残余应力提供了一种有前景的方法。混合增材制造（AM）涉及使用二次能源或工艺在特定位置制造功能梯度部件。每个混合层或步骤细化晶粒尺寸，增加位错密度，并因此改变残余应力。本研究采用有限元模型模拟混合增材制造部件中的残余应力。利用机器学习（ML），我们预测应力水平和混合层的位置。总共1000次模拟生成了足够大的数据集供机器学习模型使用。偏最小二乘回归（PLSR）预测残余应力的平均绝对误差（MAE）约为3兆帕，小于混合增材制造层中残余应力的1%。同时，混合层的位置在共振模式中表现出简并性，需要更稳健的算法。机器学习模型能够使用80%的数据作为训练集，在0.14毫米内预测混合层的位置。这项工作为未来通过实验性共振超声光谱结合有限元建模和机器学习进行非侵入性和非破坏性残余应力测量奠定了基础。

articles.title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for defect size of aluminum plates based on normal coaxial dual receiving coil ECT probe
articles.title_cn: 基于法向同轴双接收线圈ECT探头的铝板缺陷尺寸定量评价方法
articles.abstract_en: Eddy Current Testing (ECT) is a core non-destructive testing technique for conductive materials. The traditional single-coil eddy current testing method largely relies on a stable lift-off value, but in practical testing, lift-off perturbations caused by vibrations of the testing equipment directly affects the quality of the eddy current signal, thereby reducing the accuracy of defect evaluation. In this paper, a quantitative evaluation method for aluminum plate defect size based on a normal coaxial dual-receiving coil ECT probe is proposed. First, an ECT experimental system integrating signal excitation, data acquisition and motion control modules is established, and a self-designed normal coaxial dual-receiving coil ECT probe is adopted to realize the joint acquisition of eddy current signals under different lift-off values. A signal symmetrization preprocessing procedure based on flip interpolation and fourth-order low-pass filtering is also established to eliminate the asymmetric perturbation caused by mechanical vibration and platform fluctuation. Second, a three-dimensional finite element simulation model of eddy current based on the normal coaxial dual-receiving coil probe is established, and the distribution laws of the magnetic field and eddy current field are analyzed to verify the reliability of the probe structure design. Finally, ECT experiments and defect size evaluation studies are conducted on aluminum plates with surface circular hole defects, and a fast calculation model for eddy current signals is established based on the testing data of these defects. A quantitative evaluation method for aluminum plate surface defect size that takes lift-off perturbation into account is further constructed based on the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. This research finds that the peak-to-peak voltage feature of surface circular hole defect signals shows a monotonic correlation with both defect parameters and lift-off values under a lift-off perturbation range of −0.2 mm to 0.2 mm. In the presence of lift-off perturbation, the traditional single-coil ECT method results in an evaluation error of more than 38%, while the proposed ECT system can quantitatively evaluate the radius and depth of circular hole defects with errors controlled within ±0.5% and 4%, respectively. This work provides reliable technical support for the quantitative testing of surface defects in conductive materials under complex industrial conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 涡流检测（ECT）是对导电材料进行无损检测的核心技术。传统的单线圈涡流检测方法在很大程度上依赖于稳定的提离值，但在实际检测中，检测设备振动引起的提离扰动直接影响涡流信号的质量，从而降低缺陷评价的准确性。本文提出了一种基于法向同轴双接收线圈ECT探头的铝板缺陷尺寸定量评价方法。首先，建立了集成信号激励、数据采集和运动控制模块的ECT实验系统，并采用自行设计的法向同轴双接收线圈ECT探头，实现了不同提离值下涡流信号的联合采集。还建立了基于翻转插值和四阶低通滤波的信号对称化预处理程序，以消除机械振动和平台波动引起的不对称扰动。其次，建立了基于法向同轴双接收线圈探头的涡流三维有限元仿真模型，分析了磁场和涡流场的分布规律，验证了探头结构设计的可靠性。最后，对具有表面圆孔缺陷的铝板进行了ECT实验和缺陷尺寸评价研究，并基于这些缺陷的检测数据建立了涡流信号的快速计算模型。进一步基于粒子群优化（PSO）算法，构建了考虑提离扰动的铝板表面缺陷尺寸定量评价方法。研究发现，在提离扰动范围为−0.2 mm至0.2 mm时，表面圆孔缺陷信号的峰峰值电压特征与缺陷参数和提离值均呈单调相关。在存在提离扰动的情况下，传统单线圈ECT方法的评价误差超过38%，而所提出的ECT系统能够定量评价圆孔缺陷的半径和深度，误差分别控制在±0.5%和4%以内。这项工作为复杂工业条件下导电材料表面缺陷的定量检测提供了可靠的技术支持。

articles.title_en: Screen-Printed functional materials for energy storage and Harvesting: From Fundamentals to integrated supercapacitors and nanogenerators
articles.title_cn: 用于能量存储与采集的丝网印刷功能材料：从基础到集成超级电容器和纳米发电机
articles.abstract_en: Flexible electronics and self-powered wearable systems require fabrication platforms that simultaneously enable high-performance energy storage and harvesting on conformable substrates at industrial scale, yet no single method has consolidated these capabilities with the reproducibility demanded by practical deployment. Screen-printing addresses this gap through precise ink deposition, minimal material waste, and compatibility with polymers, textiles, and paper across roll-to-roll production formats. This review critically synthesizes progress in screen-printed supercapacitors and nanogenerators, providing unified analysis of ink engineering, electrode materials, device architectures, and integration strategies that existing reviews treat independently. Electrode materials spanning carbon systems, MXenes, transition metal oxides, conducting polymers, and hybrid nanocomposites are appraised, with the literature reporting areal capacitances up to 4979 mF/cm2, energy densities reaching 62 µWh/cm2, and cycling retention exceeding 90% after 10,000 cycles. Mechanical stability under repeated bending and substrate adhesion over extended operation are evaluated alongside electrochemical performance. Screen-printed piezoelectric, triboelectric, and pyroelectric nanogenerators, directly interfaced with printed supercapacitors in self-powered configurations, deliver output voltages reaching 103 V. Batch reproducibility and process standardization are examined as prerequisites for transitioning screen-printing from laboratory prototyping to scalable manufacturing. Machine learning-guided optimization, hybrid printing approaches, and multifunctional ink design are identified as convergent pathways toward this goal.
articles.abstract_cn: 柔性电子和自供电可穿戴系统需要能够在工业规模下于适形基底上同时实现高性能能量存储和采集的制造平台，然而目前尚无单一方法能够将这些能力与实际部署所需的可重复性相结合。丝网印刷通过精确的油墨沉积、最少的材料浪费以及与聚合物、纺织品和纸张在卷对卷生产格式中的兼容性，弥补了这一差距。本综述批判性地综合了丝网印刷超级电容器和纳米发电机的研究进展，提供了对油墨工程、电极材料、器件架构和集成策略的统一分析，而现有综述则对这些方面分别处理。涵盖碳系统、MXenes、过渡金属氧化物、导电聚合物和混合纳米复合材料的电极材料得到了评估，文献报道的面积电容高达4979 mF/cm2，能量密度达到62 µWh/cm2，循环保持率在10,000次循环后超过90%。在评估电化学性能的同时，还评估了重复弯曲下的机械稳定性和长时间运行中的基底附着力。与印刷超级电容器直接接口的丝网印刷压电、摩擦电和热释电纳米发电机，在自供电配置中实现了高达103 V的输出电压。批次可重复性和工艺标准化被视为将丝网印刷从实验室原型制作过渡到可扩展制造的先决条件。机器学习引导的优化、混合印刷方法和多功能油墨设计被确定为实现这一目标的汇聚途径。

articles.title_en: Eddy current thermography with intensity-varied magnetization for identification of internal and external wall-thinning defects
articles.title_cn: 变强度磁化涡流热成像用于内外壁减薄缺陷的识别
articles.abstract_en: Copyright © 2026. Published by Elsevier Ltd. An intensity-varied magnetization eddy current thermography (VIM-ECT) method for defect characterization is proposed. The proposed method integrates adjustable direct-current (DC) bias magnetization, which induces localized Magnetic permeability perturbation (MPP), with high-frequency alternating current (AC) excitation to differentiate the thermal responses of internal versus external defects. Experimental results reveal that internal thinning defects exhibit critical magnetization-current behavior and characteristic W-shaped dual-peak thermal profiles, whereas external defects mainly present U-shaped profiles with weaker magnetization-modulated variation. The average peak-to-valley temperature difference (ΔT pv ‾) of internal defects shows stronger current dependence, and its coefficient of determination (R 2 ) is generally higher than that of external defects. Since R 2 mainly reflects fitting consistency, normalized slope variation (η) was introduced to quantify magnetization sensitivity. A multi-index uncertainty analysis further confirms that internal defects exhibit higher η values, while the sensitivity separation (D η ) remains positive, with its 95% confidence interval exceeding the preset margin. The method identifies wall-thinning defects with 4.2% thickness loss in 8–12 mm ferromagnetic specimens within 200 ms, providing a dynamic strategy for defect-side discrimination based on magnetization sensitivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 版权所有 © 2026。由Elsevier Ltd出版。提出了一种用于缺陷表征的变强度磁化涡流热成像（VIM-ECT）方法。该方法将可调直流（DC）偏置磁化（诱导局部磁导率扰动（MPP））与高频交流（AC）激励相结合，以区分内部缺陷与外部缺陷的热响应。实验结果表明，内部减薄缺陷表现出临界磁化电流行为和特征性的W形双峰热剖面，而外部缺陷主要呈现U形剖面，且磁化调制变化较弱。内部缺陷的平均峰谷温差（ΔT pv ‾）表现出更强的电流依赖性，其决定系数（R 2）通常高于外部缺陷。由于R 2主要反映拟合一致性，引入了归一化斜率变化（η）来量化磁化敏感性。多指标不确定性分析进一步证实，内部缺陷表现出更高的η值，而敏感性分离度（D η）保持为正，其95%置信区间超过预设裕度。该方法在200 ms内识别出8-12 mm铁磁试样中厚度损失为4.2%的减薄缺陷，为基于磁化敏感性的缺陷侧判别提供了一种动态策略。
